title: Underwater bionic robot motion control method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of underwater robot control, and discloses an underwater bionic robot motion control method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining collected tail construction data, constructing a tail kinematics model according to the tail construction data, and constructing a tail kinematics model according to the tail kinematics model; according to the tail kinematic model, constructing a target kinetic model of the underwater bionic robot; obtaining preset design data, constructing a motion observer and a navigation strategy of the underwater bionic robot according to the design data, and training the constructed underwater bionic robot according to the target kinetic model to obtain optimal strategy information; and deploying an optimal strategy corresponding to the optimal strategy information to the underwater bionic robot to realize accurate motion control. According to the invention, accurate motion control of the underwater bionic robot is realized.

title: Underwater cable deployment system and method
abstract: An underwater cable deployment system includes a series of cables, pre-wound on a set of reels, disposed upon a pallet and connected to a distribution hub on the pallet. The pallet is lowered to the ocean floor and a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) is also lowered to the ocean floor to deploy cables to form a predetermined array on the ocean floor. Preferably, the pallet is delivered to the ocean floor in advance by crane with the reel-mounted sensor array cables being deployed later by ROV. Optionally, the ROV may include a jetting package configured to bury the sensor cable as it is being deployed from the reel on the ROV.
note: borderline: ROV deploys cables

title: Buoy garbage collecting and automatic feeding intelligent robot for aquaculture
abstract: The invention discloses a floating garbage collecting and automatic feeding intelligent robot for aquaculture. The floating garbage collecting and automatic feeding intelligent robot comprises a sealing cover; the buoy collecting cover is movably arranged on the outer side of the sealing cover in a sleeving manner; the top of the storage inner barrel is in sealed connection with a sealing cover, and the top of the outer collection barrel is in floating connection with a buoy collection cover to form a buoy collection bin; the discharging inner cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the buoy collecting cylinder; the piston type float bowl is arranged between the discharging inner barrel and the material storage inner barrel, the piston type float bowl and the top of the piston type float bowl define a closed material storage bin with the variable size, and the piston type float bowl and the bottom of the piston type float bowl define a closed pressurized water bin with the variable size; the integrated discharging rod is used for downwards conveying the bait in the storage bin to the discharging cavity for feeding; and the four-direction propeller is used for driving the robot to move forwards, backwards, leftwards and rightwards. Automatic floating garbage collection and automatic bait casting are achieved, manpower is liberated, and meanwhile nutrition supply of aquatic organisms and water environment maintenance are greatly guaranteed.
note: borderline: floating surface robot

title: General purpose robotics operating system with unmanned and autonomous vehicle extensions
abstract: The present invention provides a general purpose operating system (GPROS) that shows particular usefulness in the robotics and automation fields. The operating system provides individual services and the combination and interconnections of such services using built-in service extensions, built-in completely configurable generic services, and ways to plug in additional service extensions to yield a comprehensive and cohesive framework for developing, configuring, assembling, constructing, deploying, and managing robotics and/or automation applications. The invention includes GPROS extensions and features directed to use as an autonomous vehicle operating system. The vehicle controlled by appropriate versions of the GPROS can include unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) applications such as a driverless or self-driving car. The vehicle can likewise or instead include an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) such as a helicopter or drone. In cases, the vehicle can include an unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV), such as a submarine or other submersible.
note: borderline: generic robotics operating system

title: Hull robot with hull separation countermeasures
abstract: A hull robot is disclosed for operation on a surface of a hull of a vessel. The robot can include a drive subsystem onboard the robot for driving and maneuvering the robot about the hull. A sensor subsystem onboard the robot can sense an attachment state of the robot to the hull. The attachment state can include at least one of attached and detached. A signal generation subsystem onboard the robot can emit a distress signal when the attachment state is detached.
note: borderline: hull crawler robot

title: Magnetic coupling vector propulsion omnidirectional driving underwater robot control distribution method
abstract: The invention provides a control distribution method for an omnidirectional driving underwater robot propelled by a magnetic coupling vector, and the method comprises the steps: describing a control distribution problem of a multi-vector propeller as a convex optimization problem under the constraint of a nonlinear inequality; calculation of control distribution can be carried out according to nonlinear physical characteristics of the omni-directional driving underwater robot propelled by the magnetic coupling vector; meanwhile, an augmented Lagrangian penalty function method is used for solving the optimal control distribution problem, the limitation that the controlled quantity exceeds thrust saturation can be overcome, and the operation real-time performance and the control precision can also be effectively guaranteed.

title: A SELF-PROPELLED SYSTEM OF CLEANUP, INSPECTION AND REPAIRS OF THE SURFACE OF VESSEL HULLS AND UNDERWATER OBJECTS
abstract: The invention relates to measuring and remotely-operated robotic systems for maintenance, repairs, and periodic inspection of hulls surfaces, hydraulic and oil-and-gas infrastructures, and it can be applied to precise diagnostic of deformations, chipping, visible cracks, cavities, and any other defects situated on the surface or inside the inspected objects, as well as to ensure maintenance, repairs, installation of additional equipment, grouting, and other complex above-water and underwater work operations, including works performed in the remote control mode. The system represents a remotely-operated vehicle designed to work in both environments with installed hold-down propelling thrusters and tracked-wheeled drives to horizontal and vertical movements along the surface. The carrier is designed with option to be equipped by at least one autonomous unit, which can be a manipulator module, and/or a research module, and/or an operation module, can be placed on the vehicle itself.

title: ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC COMPACT DRIVE FOR ROTATIONAL MOVEMENTS
abstract: The invention relates to an electro-hydraulic compact drive for underwater use and for driving an output element, for example a propeller (40), a wheel, or a cable winch. For this purpose, the compact unit comprises a hydraulic motor (31), which has an output shaft (37), a hydraulic pump (30), by means of which the hydraulic motor can be supplied with a hydraulic fluid via a working line (32), and an electric motor (50), by means of which the hydraulic pump can be driven, as components. The aim of the invention is to design such an electro-hydraulic drive so as to be particularly suitable for underwater use. This is achieved by an electro-hydraulic compact drive in which the components are located in a closed container (12) filled with a hydraulic fluid, and the container has an opening for coupling the output shaft of the hydraulic motor to the output element. According to the invention, the electro-hydraulic compact drive thus forms a closed unit which contains the complete electric motor/hydraulic pump/hydraulic motor arrangement. The compact drive combines the advantages of the high power density of hydraulics with a decentralized electric direct drive. A high degree of reliability, safety, and energy efficiency are achieved. The handling of the drive is simplified, thus also simplifying the control of underwater vehicles and machines.
note: compact drive for underwater use (propeller, winch)

title: SUBMERSED POSITION DIRECTING APPARATUS OF A SUBMARINE ROBOT
abstract: PURPOSE: A device for indicating a submersed position of a submarine robot is provided to rapidly confirm a submersed position of a submarine robot when the submarine robot is moved under a pre-set water level. CONSTITUTION: A device for indicating a submersed position of a submarine robot comprises a position detecting unit. The position detecting unit has a fixed member(10), a floating member(20), a position transmission unit(30), a connection rope(40), and a separated operating unit(50). The fixed member is fixed to the outer surface of a submarine robot body. The floating member is detachably coupled to the fixed member. The position transmission unit is coupled to the floating member and transmits the position of the floating member. The connection rope connects the fixed member and the floating member. The separated operating unit separates the floating member from the fixed member when the submarine robot is moved under a pre-set water level.

title: Petal-imitating mechanical claw for AUV underwater recycling grabbing and recycling system
abstract: The invention discloses a petal-imitating mechanical claw for AUV underwater recycling grabbing and a recycling system, and belongs to the technical field of AUV recycling devices. The mechanical claw comprises a tail bin unit, main petal units, a main petal driving unit, auxiliary petal units, auxiliary petal driving units and a fin ray unit, and the main petal units are installed on the front portion of the tail bin unit; one auxiliary petal unit is installed between every two adjacent main petal units, each auxiliary petal unit is composed of a plurality of parallel four-bar mechanisms, and the two auxiliary petal units form a foldable petal surface between the two corresponding adjacent main petal units; the main petal driving unit comprises a main petal driving part, and the main petal driving part is connected with the main petal units through main petal driving rods; the auxiliary petal driving units are installed on the main petal units and provided with auxiliary petal driving parts, and the auxiliary petal driving parts are connected with the auxiliary petal units through auxiliary petal driving rods; and the main petal units fix the fin ray unit. According to the mechanical claw, the recycling success rate and recycling efficiency of an AUV can be improved, the storage and moving space is saved, and the grabbing action is more stable.

title: A hydrodynamic analysis method for a grabbing movement process of an underwater robot and a manipulator system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater robots, and particularly relates to a hydrodynamic analysis method for a grabbing movement process of an underwater robot and a manipulator system. Themethod comprises a UVMS system circulating water tank test and CFD numerical simulation. The UVMS circulating water tank test comprises the steps that a plane movement mechanism is used for measuringthe stress of the UVMS in a flow field, wherein different mechanical arm postures of the UVMS are kept in the flow field; and the water tank test is reproduced by using a CFD method, and the accuracyof the CFD method is verified. CFD software is used for conducting numerical simulation on the underwater movement process of the UVMS mechanical arm, and the hydrodynamic coefficient of the underwater mechanical arm is obtained through fitting. A part of complexity can be replaced at the initial design stage of the UVMS system; according to the method, a high pool test is carried out, qualitative and quantitative analysis is carried out on the disturbance effect of the designed mechanical arm on the stress and moment of the UVMS system, the hydrodynamic coefficient of the mechanical arm based on the slice theory is obtained, then an accurate underwater mechanical arm hydrodynamic model is established, and a reference is provided for further optimization design and motion simulation of the UVMS system.

title: Bionic robotic fish motion control method and system based on adversarial structured control
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biomimetic robot control, particularly relates to a biomimetic robotic fish motion control method and system based on adversarial structured control, and aims tosolve the problems of high training difficulty, low motion efficiency and poor robustness of an existing biomimetic fish control method. The biomimetic robotic fish motion control method comprises thefollowing steps: constructing an optimization objective function by taking the precision and speed of movement to a target point as reward items and taking the sum of steering engine power as a lossitem; optimizing the parameters of the central pattern generator model generating the steering engine global control quantity, and optimizing the parameters of the steering engine compensation controlmodel after the parameters are solidified; iteratively optimizing parameters of the model; and obtaining global control and compensation control signals of the bionic robotic fish through the trainedmodel, and taking the linear combination of the two groups of output signals as a control signal of a robotic fish steering engine to realize motion control of the robotic fish. Model adversarial training is carried out by combining the global control signal and the local compensation control signal, and the training difficulty is low, and the bionic robotic fish moves accurately, and the energyconsumption is low.

title: Autonomous submersible structure
abstract: An autonomous submersible structure includes a cage for protecting cargo contained within a volume of the cage, two or more independently operated propellers, and a raised platform. The raised platform includes a plurality of sensors and computers that detect at least one of: water quality, water pressure, or objects in the vicinity of the cage. The raised platform includes a navigating system that controls a direction of travel of the cage based on feedback provided by the plurality of sensors and computers, and a power generator that provides power to the sensors, the navigating system, and the feeding mechanism. The autonomous submersible structure includes a ballast for counterbalancing the weight of the raised platform, wherein the navigating system controls the two or more independently operated propellers to alter the direction of travel of the cage, and wherein the raised platform is environmentally sealed and a portion of the raised platform is positioned above water level.
note: borderline: autonomous submersible cargo structure

title: Motion control method and system of all-attitude underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method and system for an all-attitude underwater robot, the system comprises a driving module, a movement adjusting module and a floating module, a propeller is arranged in the driving module, the all-attitude underwater robot can be driven and corrected in the descending process through the propeller, the all-attitude underwater robot is prevented from deviating from a to-be-detected point, and the detection accuracy is improved. The robot can accurately fall to a target location; through the movement adjusting module, the underwater movement process of the all-attitude underwater robot can be adjusted, the all-attitude underwater robot can cross obstacles to continue probing, and in the recovery process, buoyancy can be provided for the all-attitude underwater robot through the floating module, so that the all-attitude underwater robot automatically floats on the liquid level in the recovery process, and the all-attitude underwater robot is more intelligent.

title: Sea-air-submersible integrated inspection system based on small unmanned ship
abstract: The invention provides a sea-air-submersible integrated inspection system based on a small unmanned ship. The system comprises a mooring type unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system (1), a shipborneinspection system (2), an unmanned ship platform (4) and a mooring type underwater robot inspection system (5), the unmanned ship platform (4) comprises a fixed portal frame (4.2) and an unmanned ship body (4.19); the unmanned ship body (4.19) is in a wave-resistant catamaran shape. Wherein the mooring type unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system (1) comprises a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (1.1) and an unmanned aerial vehicle landing platform (1.4), and the mooring type underwater robot inspection system (5) comprises a remote control winch (5.1), an underwater GPS receiver array (5.4), an underwater inspection robot (5.7) and an underwater GPS positioner (5.8). The inspection system has the characteristics of powerful function, high efficiency, continuous operation, low inspection cost and the like, and can meet the requirements of rapidly increased wind power plant installed capacity and other large-scale ocean engineering equipment on inspection equipment.
note: borderline: unmanned ship with tethered underwater robot (hybrid)

title: Underwater docking device for autonomous underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous underwater robot underwater docking device, the underwater docking device comprises a docking mechanism, a power storage mechanism and a buffer mechanism, the power storage mechanism is arranged below the docking mechanism, the docking mechanism is fixed with the buffer mechanism, and the docking mechanism carries out docking and recovery on an underwater robot. The power storage mechanism uses water flow to generate electricity to provide power to the docking device, and the buffer mechanism uses water flow to buffer the recovery of the underwater robot. The underwater docking device is scientific, reasonable and safe and convenient to use, the power storage mechanism carries out hydroelectric generation through tidal current energy, the power needed by normal work is provided for the docking device, the buffer mechanism compresses seawater and jets the compressed seawater out of the docking mechanism, and the buffer mechanism buffers the underwater robot through the jetted water flow to prevent the underwater robot from colliding with the docking mechanism due to too high speed in the docking mechanism.

title: High precision method for measuring height of underwater topography of pile foundation of pile group of offshore wind plant
abstract: The invention discloses a high precision method for measuring the height of underwater topography of pile foundation of a pile group of an offshore wind plant. The method comprises following steps: step one, installing a three dimensional scanning sonar on a remote-controlled unmanned submersible; step two, determining the positions and number of measuring points for data collection; step three, remote-controlling the unmanned submersible with the three dimensional scanning sonar to carry out three dimensional scanning imaging in each measuring point so as to obtain the shape of underwater topography; step four, after detection is finished, recovering the unmanned submersible, and collecting the point cloud data; step five, collecting multi-beam point cloud data by a ship mounted multi-beam system; and step six, superposing the three dimensional scanning sonar and multi-beam point cloud data. The provided method can fill up the data blank of multi-beam scanning, can detect the underwater topography of an offshore wind plant in the east sea, and obtains high precision sludge height data.

title: Wireless water area three-dimensional monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a wireless water area three-dimensional monitoring system which comprises a data center, the output end of the data center is electrically connected with an image forming module and a controller, the input end of the data center is electrically connected with an upper computer, and the input end of the upper computer is provided with a wireless receiving/transmitting antenna. According to the invention, underwater, water surface and overwater detection work can be synchronously carried out, so that three-dimensional detection work can be carried out in real time, and meanwhile, detection work and acquisition work can be rapidly carried out in different fixed-point directions through the unmanned submarine, the unmanned ship and the unmanned aircraft, so that the efficiency can be improved; through the small wind driven generator, the solar power generation panel and the small hydroelectric generator, power generation work and power storage work can be conducted in real time in the using process of the unmanned submarine, the unmanned ship and the unmanned aircraft, and therefore electric power resources can be saved, and cost can be reduced.
note: water-area monitoring system

title: Autonomous submersible offshore marine platform
abstract: It is an object of the present invention to provide a means of constructing an Autonomous fully-Submersible Offshore Marine Platform (ASOMP) of considerable warfighting or commercial capability which is mobile and can autonomously transport to a hazardous operating area in a low-observable reduced vulnerability manner, fully submerge to avoid the military or environmental threat hazard, hibernate until needed, perform fully submerged mobility and mission operations, surface and provide Barge and SWATH surface ship mobility and mission operations, resubmerge if the hazardous threat appears and relocate to a new operating area. Another object of the present invention is to provide a fully autonomous and submersible low-cost “lily-pad” that surfaces when called and provides a main deck platform at appropriate freeboard and seakeeping motions to function as a refueling landing zone and pier to extend the range of aircraft and marine vehicles operating in a high-threat environment.
note: borderline: autonomous submersible platform

title: Fluctuation fin propulsion underwater operation robot tracking control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of autonomous control of underwater operation robots, particularly relates to a fluctuation fin propulsion underwater operation robot tracking control method, systemand device based on reinforcement learning, and aims to solve the problem of low target tracking precision caused by poor convergence and stability of an Actor network in the training process. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring system state information of an underwater operation robot at a moment t and pose information of a to-be-tracked target under an on-body coordinate systemof the underwater operation robot, and constructing state information st of a Markov decision process; obtaining the fluctuation frequency at of a fluctuation fin through an Actor network in an Actor-Critic reinforcement learning model based on the st; and controlling the fluctuation fin of the underwater operation robot based on at, wherein t is made to be equal to t+1, and conducting circulationis conducted. According to the invention, Actor network training is supervised through a PID controller, the stability and convergence of the network are improved, and the target tracking precision is improved.

title: Launch and rescue device integrated system for e.g. watercraft, has retainer arranged for settling swimming apparatus or for receiving swimming apparatus by joggle region, and float floating on water around pivotal axis of construction
abstract: The system has a multi-arm construction (3) in which arm elements are articulated and connected, and a swimming apparatus (6) e.g. autonomous underwater craft, for transportation between a joggle region (15) and a bordering device or surrounding water. The multi-arm construction is swingable supported by an articulation unit (7). A float floats on water around a pivotal axis of the multi-arm construction between suspension position and rescue position. A retainer (4) is arranged for settling the swimming apparatus on or for receiving the swimming apparatus by the joggle region.

title: Connecting and locking mechanism of underwater structure
abstract: The invention discloses a connecting and locking mechanism of an underwater structure. The connecting and locking mechanism comprises a locking pin rod mounted on the underwater structure, an underwater robot operating handle connected onto the locking pin rod, and a pin rod limiting tube which is arranged on the locking pin rod in a sleeving mode, wherein the side surface of the locking pin rod is connected with a limiting rod; the locking pin rod is connected with the underwater robot operating handle through an opening pin; and a limiting slot capable of limiting the locking pin rod from sliding is formed in the surface of the pin rod limiting tube. According to the connecting locking mechanism disclosed by the invention, a joint of the underwater structure is more reliable, and the problem that influences are easily caused by external load such as a fishing net is solved; moreover, a diver does not need to operate, and an underwater robot can operate, so that safety risk of the operator is avoided, safety of underwater operation of oil-gas filed production is greatly improved, and mounting cost is reduced; and meanwhile, the underwater robot operating handle can be recycled, so that a connecting failure problem caused by hooking or colliding of the protruded handle is avoided.
note: borderline: ROV-operated locking tool

title: Intelligent flap underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent flap underwater robot, and belongs to the field of robots. An energy bin and a main load bin of the intelligent flap underwater robot are installed to form an overall machine body structure. A transparent hemispherical cover is arranged at the front section of a main control bin. Foldable and unfoldable automatic aerofoils are arranged on the main control bin. The automatic aerofoils are driven by a steering engine driving mechanism to act. The steering engine driving mechanism is arranged in the main control bin, and the energy bin supplies power to thesteering engine driving mechanism, A power system is arranged at the tail portion of the main load bin. According to the intelligent flap underwater robot, the advantage of rapid submerging speed dueto the streamline form can be achieved, and the unfolded frame type stable operation capacity is achieved; the foldable aerofoils are added to the two sides of the streamline-form structure main bin,the aerofoils are unfolded during operation, and the stabilizing and balancing effect can be achieved; the aerofoils are folded during submerging, and submerging can be rapidly conducted. Due to thestructure, by adjusting the posture of the aerofoils, the intelligent flap underwater robot can adapt to different marine environments.

title: Underwater robot positioning system based on double-manipulator encircling pile column
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot positioning system based on a double-manipulator encircling pile column. The underwater robot positioning system comprises a water surface console and an underwater working robot capable of being absorbed to the pile column. The two sides of the underwater working robot are symmetrically provided with double hydraulic encircling manipulators for tightly holding the pile column. The water surface console is connected with the underwater working robot through a signal and used for controlling the actions of the underwater working robot and the double hydraulic encircling manipulators. By the adoption of the underwater robot positioning system, the positioning capacity and the working efficiency of the underwater working robot are improved greatly, and the problems that the energy consumption of the power positioning manner of the robot is high, it is difficult for the manipulators to align with a target due to the fact that the robot position shakes and consequently the working efficiency is low are solved effectively.

title: Biomimetic long-fin undulatory propulsion robotic fish
abstract: The invention relates to a biomimetic long-fin undulatory propulsion robotic fish which comprises a robotic fish main body that comprises a cylindrical shell and two hemispherical end covers respectively buckled at the two sides of the cylindrical shell, and a sealed cavity is formed by the cylindrical shell and the two hemispherical end covers; the sealed cavity is internally provided with a steering engine; the steering engine extends to the outside of the cylindrical shell by a steering engine power output shaft through an axle hole formed in the cylindrical shell; the steering engine power output shaft is arranged on the top of the outside of the cylindrical shell and is provided with a first bevel gear; the robotic fish also comprises an undulatory fin mechanism which comprises a gear box mechanism and a fin ray, wherein the gear box mechanism comprises a gear box shell provided with an opening at the bottom; the side wall of the gear box shell is provided with a fin ray power output shaft; the fin ray power output shaft is arranged on the top in the gear box shell and is provided with a second bevel gear; and the fin ray is fixed at the end of the fin ray power output shaft, arranged outside the gear box shell.

title: Suction anchor device for unmanned underwater vehicle to reside on seabed and control method of suction anchor device
abstract: The invention provides a suction anchor device for an unmanned underwater vehicle to reside on seabed and a control method of the suction anchor device. The suction anchor device comprises a cable rope, a suction bucket, a watertight motor, an impeller pump, a power supply and control watertight case, a water suction pipeline, an external filter, an internal filter, a water inlet pipeline, a water outlet, a water inlet, an external pressure sensor, a water pumping T-shaped electromagnetic ball valve, a water drainage T-shaped electromagnetic ball valve, an internal pressure sensor, a gyroscope and an in-place switch. The control method of the suction anchor device for the UUV to reside on the seabed comprises an anchor falling method, an anchor fixing method and an anchor weighing method. The suction anchor device has the advantages of being convenient to reside on the seabed, easy to recycle and easy to adjust, and has good transverse and longitudinal bearing capacity. In addition, by means of the residing method, the UUV can have the capacity of residing on the seabed for multiple times, and the risk that the UUV is displaced or buried by silt due to the ocean current effect when the UUV resides on the seabed for a long time is avoided.

title: Autonomous underwater system for a 4D environmental monitoring
abstract: An autonomous underwater system for environmental monitoring including a multidisciplinary underwater station including onboard instrumentation, at least one autonomous modular underwater vehicle movable inside an area to be monitored along an assigned route, and at least one external instrumental modulus which can be connected the vehicle, wherein the multidisciplinary underwater station includes a docking area, an interface system, an equipping system for supplying the vehicle with instrumental moduli, and a management system.

title: Autonomous data acquisition system and method
abstract: A submersible node and a method and system for using the node to acquire data, including seismic data is disclosed. The node incorporates a buoyancy system to provide propulsion for the node between respective landed locations by varying the buoyancy between positive and negative. A first acoustic positioning system is used to facilitate positioning of a node when landing and a second acoustic positioning system is used to facilitate a node transiting between respective target landed locations.
note: borderline: mobile seismic node with buoyancy propulsion

title: Unmanned underwater vehicle propulsion system including an AC power distribution bus
abstract: A propulsion system for an unmanned underwater vehicle includes a turbine engine having a rotational output, an electrical generator mechanically connected to the rotational output and electrically connected to an Alternating Current (AC) power bus. A magnitude of an AC output of the electrical generator is independent of rotational speed of the rotational input. An electrical motor connected to the AC power bus, and includes a mechanical output.

title: Sea and air dual-purpose aircraft
abstract: The invention discloses a sea and air dual-purpose aircraft. The aircraft comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a glider and is characterized in that the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle isconnected with the glider through a dragging device and a traction device, solar cell panels are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of a cabin of the unmanned aerial vehicle and connected with acontroller in the cabin of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that power is automatically supplied, electric energy is supplied to the controller and supplied to electronic equipments such as the underwater glider and the unmanned aerial vehicle for control of the underwater glider and communication of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the underwater glider and the unmanned aerial vehicle work continuously for a long time; and due to the fact that the above structure is adopted, quick detection and long-term monitoring can be conducted, and the aircraft has the beneficial effects of being novel in structure, stable in operation, high in cruising capacity, low in energy consumption, capable of saving energy and automatically supplying power, long in operation time, high in movement speed and the like.
note: borderline: aerial drone towing a glider (hybrid)

title: SELF-POWERED, SELF-PROPELLED COMPUTE GRID WITH LOOP TOPOLOGY
abstract: An energy-harvesting compute grid includes computing assemblies that cooperate with mobile energy harvesters configured to be deployed on a body of water. The plurality of energy harvesters are positioned on and move adjacent to an upper surface of a body of water, and the locations of the energy harvesters can be monitored and controlled. The widespread gathering by the harvesters of environmental data within that geospatial area permits the forecasting of environmental factors, the discovery of advantageous energy-harvesting opportunities, the observation and tracking of hazardous objects and conditions, the efficient distribution of data and/or tasks to and between the harvesters included in the compute grid, the efficient execution of logistical operations to support, upgrade, maintain, and repair the cluster, and the opportunity to execute data-gathering across an area much larger than that afforded by an individual harvester (e.g., radio astronomy, 3D tracking of and recording of the communication patterns of marine mammals, etc.). The computational tasks can be shared and distributed among a compute grid implemented in part by a collection of individual floating self-propelled energy harvesters thereby providing many benefits related to cost and efficiency that are unavailable to relatively isolated energy harvesters, and likewise unavailable to terrestrial compute grids of the prior art.
note: surface energy harvesters

title: Offshore energy supply system
abstract: An offshore energy supply system 1 comprising an energy supply module 2 to supply energy from an energy supply to a user 7, at least one energy supply connection means 8 for connecting the energy supply module to the energy supply, and a user connection means 4 for connecting the energy supply module to the user. The energy supply module may be configured to be located on a seabed 9. Th energy may be electrical energy. The energy may be a fuel such as hydrogen, ammonia or methanol. The connection may comprise a cable, hose or other conduit. The user connection means may comprise a buoyancy element which may be located below the sea surface. The user may be a ship, boat, or other vessel which is recharged or refuelled by the energy supply system. A remote operated vehicle may be used to facilitate the connection between the energy supply system and the user. There is also disclosed a method of installing on offshore energy supply system.
note: offshore energy supply

title: Unmanned air and underwater vehicle
abstract: An unmanned vehicle including a body and a frame structure extending from the body and supporting a plurality of propeller assemblies, each propeller assembly including at least one propeller and a corresponding motor with the motor housed in a watertight housing or coated and made corrosion resistant. The propellers comprise a first subset of propellers of the propeller assemblies and a second subset of propellers of the propeller assemblies which rotate in a plane positioned below a plane in which the first subset of propellers rotate, wherein said first and second subset of propellers are configured for independent operation of one another as the vehicle transitions from an air medium to a water medium.

title: Underwater encircling device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to an underwater encircling device. The underwater encircling device comprises a control mechanism and an executing mechanism connected with the control mechanism, wherein the executing mechanism comprises four three-degree-of-freedom mechanical arms, each of the left side and the right side of the executing mechanism is symmetrically provided with two three-degree-of-freedom mechanical arms, and a suction mechanism is arranged at the tail end of each three-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; the control mechanism is used for issuing an encircling instruction to the executing mechanism; the executing mechanism is used for responding to the encircling instruction issued by the control mechanism; and the suction mechanisms are used for achieving efficient suction of the a target structural part. According to the underwater encircling device, the mechanical arms are controlled through servo motor controllers, so that the encircling suction action is completed; the underwater encircling device can work independently, can also be carried on an underwater maintenance robot, and cooperates with the robot to complete underwater work through communication of a prepared control protocol; and the underwater encircling robot can perform underwater encircling operation fully automatically and stably.

title: High power laser photo-conversion assemblies, apparatuses and methods of use
abstract: There is provided a high power laser system for powering a remotely located laser device, such as an ROV, using a high power laser fiber optic tether and a photo-conversion device, such as a laser photovoltaic assembly. Laser device systems, such as ROV systems that utilizes a high power laser cutting and/or cleaning tools are also provided.
note: borderline: laser power for ROV

title: O-shaped ring auxiliary assembly tool and assembly method for butt joint of AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) cabin sections
abstract: The invention discloses an O-shaped ring auxiliary assembly tool for AUV cabin butt joint and an assembly method. The O-shaped ring auxiliary assembly tool comprises two pipe hoops and two butt joint driving mechanisms. The two butt joint driving mechanisms are oppositely arranged between the two pipe hoops front and back, each butt joint driving mechanism comprises a twisting rod rotating device and a rope, the two ends of the rope are connected with the two pipe hoops respectively, the twisting rod rotating device is provided with a connecting rotating end connected with the rope, and the connecting rotating end rotates around a rotating axis perpendicular to the extending direction of the rope; and the rope is wound on the periphery of the connecting rotating end, so that the two pipe hoops are close to each other. The two pipe hoops can be arranged on the periphery of the AUV cabin section in a sleeving mode, punching in the surface of the AUV cabin section is avoided, the installation difficulty is lowered, installation is more reliable and safer, the number of workers is reduced, the situation that the O-shaped ring is damaged due to manual extrusion and the O-shaped ring is installed repeatedly is avoided, and the work amount is greatly reduced.
note: borderline: assembly tool for AUV

title: Underwater robot navigation obstacle avoidance method based on visual image and laser radar
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot navigation obstacle avoidance method based on a visual image and a laser radar. The method comprises the following steps: creating a 3D grid map by using laser radar data in an underwater working area; sending a navigation target point to a navigation module of the underwater robot; enabling the navigation module to plan a walking path from the current position to the target point according to the target point and the current position; enabling the navigation module to calculate the relative speed between the underwater robot and an obstacle in the movement process according to the visual image and the laser radar data, so the optimal movement speed of the underwater robot at the next moment is calculated in real time according to a speed conflict detection method; controlling the underwater robot to move according to the optimal movement speed, and repeating the previous steps until the underwater robot reaches the target point. The safety speed boundary is set by using the laser radar and the visual image data and considering the relative movement speed factor so that the probability of movement conflict between the underwater robot andthe obstacle can be reduced and the safety and fluency of movement of the underwater robot can be enhanced.

title: Underwater automatic docking mechanism for ROV
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater automatic docking mechanism for an ROV(remotely operated vehicle). The underwater automatic docking mechanism comprises a mounting seat, wherein an axial hole and a radial through slot I which are in communication are formed in the mounting seat; an oil cylinder piston rod extends into the axial hole, and a pushing head is hinged to the piston rod; the mounting seat is fixedly connected with a conical guide head with a radial through slot II, and the two radial through slots communicate to form mounting spaces for locking blocks, and the two locking blocks are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the pushing head; the locking blocks are hinged to one side wall of the radial through slot I, the shape of the cross section of each of the locking blocks is triangular, and springs are connected between the locking blocks and the bottom of the radial through slot II; under the action of the springs, the end surfaces of the outer sides of the two locking blocks are at the vertical positions or the lower ends of the two locking blocks are close to the tilted position of the axis of the mounting seat, and the tops of the two locking blocks are in docked connection with the bottom of the pushing head; a docking block is provided with an axial through hole, and an outwards-expanding tapered hole is formed in the lower part of the axial through hole; during docking, the mounting seat extends into the axial through hole, and the locking blocks are driven by the oil cylinder to rotate, until the end surfaces of the outer sides of the locking blocks are in docked connection with the wall surface of the tapered hole. According to the underwater automatic docking mechanism, the automatic docking of the ROV and underwater equipment can be realized.
note: v1 focal patent

title: Underwater high-lift low-altitude airfoil profile
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater high-lift low-altitude airfoil profile which is applied to a wing tip position or a wing root position. When the airfoil is applied to the tip position of a wing, the lift coefficient of the airfoil is 1.0, the maximum relative thickness is 12%, the maximum thickness position is 23.9% C, the maximum camber is 2.87%, and the maximum camber position is 25.6% C; wherein C is the chord length, and all the parameters take the chord length of 1 as a reference; according to the performance requirements of lift wings of an underwater ocean current energy power generation device, a family of airfoils which are high in lift force, high in lift-drag ratio, gentle in stall and anti-cavitation and are suitable for underwater high-lift-force wings are designed, the performance of the airfoils is standard for foreign NACA6 and NACA2 series airfoils, and the airfoils have the advantages of being high in lift force, anti-cavitation and gentle in stall performance; and the requirements of underwater high-lift wings on airfoil performance are met.
note: airfoil for underwater wings (underwater gliders)

title: KITE-POWERED UNMANNED UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract: A wind-powered unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) system can include a kite subsystem configured to be powered by wind energy, a control pod coupled with the kite subsystem and configured to control the kite sub-system, a payload platform configured to provide a mechanical structure on which at least one module may be mounted, a submersible UUV, and a coupling device configured to physically couple between the kite sub-system and the submersible UUV.

title: Parameterization method capable of being applied to wing body fusion underwater glider shape design
abstract: The invention relates to a parameterization method capable of being applied to wing body fusion underwater glider shape design. The method includes: dividing a glider parameterization shape into a plane shape and a section shape; generating parameter equations of a front-end Bessel curve, a front-end linear airfoil profile, a rear-end Bessel curve and a rear-end linear airfoil profile; calculatingthe variable quantity of the section airfoil profile, and applying the variable quantity to the selected section shape reference airfoil profile curve to obtain changed section airfoil profile parameters; calculating a span value and a height value corresponding to each section wing section to obtain a coordinate value of the actual section wing section of the parameterized appearance; and combining the glider plane shape parameters and the section airfoil parameters, and setting out the curve group to obtain the actual glider geometric shape. According to the parameterization method, parameterization of various similar types of gliders such as the wing body fusion underwater glider can be effectively carried out, the application range is wide, the parameter significance is clear, appearance design and optimization of the wing body fusion underwater glider are facilitated, and the parameterization problem is solved for research of hydrodynamic performance of the glider.

title: High speed surface craft and submersible vehicle
abstract: A water craft comprising: an elongated hull comprising a passageway having an inlet and an outlet; a pump jet disposed within said passageway intermediate said inlet and said outlet; said pump jet being configured to receive water entering said passageway through said inlet and pump said water out of said outlet, whereby to propel said hull through water; a plurality of nozzles disposed on the outer surface of said hull, aft of said inlet, wherein said plurality of nozzles are configured to release a friction-reducing fluid, whereby the friction-reducing fluid displaces water from the surface of said hull so as to diminish friction on the outer surface of said hull and facilitate high speeds.
note: surface craft and submersible vehicle; crew not stated

title: UNMANNED SUBMERSIBLE USING WAVE ENERGY AS A DRIVING FORCE AND OFFSHORE MOBILE SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to an unmanned submersible using wave energy as a propelling force and an offshore mobile system using the same and, more specifically, to an unmanned submersible capable of providing a propelling force such that a surface boat can keep moving forward without separate energy supply by converting the vertical movement of the surface boat by waves into a continuous propelling force. According to the present invention, the unmanned submersible includes: a housing supported by a support member to a lower side of a surface boat floating on the surface of the sea; a seawater pocket installed to be contractible and expandable in the housing to suction and store seawater from the front of the housing when expanded, and to generate a propelling force by injecting the stored seawater to the rear of the housing when contracted; and a displacement plate installed to be displaceable while combined with the seawater pocket in the housing to be displaced relative to the housing due to the surface boat lifted by waves while deforming the seawater pocket to cause the front suction and rear injection of the seawater.
note: unmanned submersible unit of a wave-driven system

title: Cable connection system for underwater vehicle
abstract: A system for interconnecting a mother ship with a submersible vehicle using a cable towed by the mother ship. The cable has a first cable end connected to the mother ship and a second cable end to be connected to the submersible vehicle. The second cable end is provided with a first connector. A capturing mast is arranged at the submersible vehicle for capturing the cable towed by the mother ship. A connector holder is arranged at the submersible vehicle for holding the first connector when it is to be connected to a second connector. The second connector is connected to the submersible vehicle. A first guide is arranged at the submersible vehicle for guiding the first connector towards the connector holder of the submersible vehicle. A second guide turns the connector to a well defined position into the connector holder.
note: borderline: cable link mother ship to submersible vehicle

title: Controllable buoys and networked buoy systems
abstract: Buoyant sensor networks are described, comprising floating buoys with sensors and energy harvesting capabilities. The buoys can control their buoyancy and motion, and can organize communication in a distributed fashion. Some buoys may have tethered underwater vehicles with a smart spooling system that allows the vehicles to dive deep underwater while remaining in communication and connection with the buoys.
note: borderline: buoys with tethered underwater vehicles

title: AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) three-dimensional path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention designs an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) three-dimensional path planning method based on reinforcement learning. The AUV three-dimensional path planning method comprises the following steps: firstly, modeling a known underwater working environment, and performing global path planning for an AUV; secondly, designing a bonus value specific to a special working environment and a planning target of the AUV, performing obstacle avoidance training on the AUV by using a Q learning method improved on the basis of a self-organizing neural network, and writing an obstacle avoidance strategy obtained by training into an internal control system of a robot; and finally receiving global path planning nodes after the robot enters into water, calculating a target heading plan by the AUV with the global path planning nodes as target nodes for planning a route, and avoiding obstacles by using the obstacle avoidance strategy in case of emergent obstacles. Through adoption of the method, the economical efficiency of the AUV routing path is ensured, and the security in case of emergent obstacles is ensured. Meanwhile, the route planning accuracy can be improved; the planning time isshortened; and the environmental adaptability of the AUV is enhanced. The method can be applied to the AUV which carriers an obstacle avoidance sonar and can implement autonomous routing.

title: ACTIVE GEOMETRIC EXOSKELETON WITH PSEUDO-RHOMBOHEDRAL ANNULAR FAIRING FOR GYROPENDULAR CRAFT
abstract: The invention relates to an active geometric exoskeleton device (FIG. l) for a multi environment, multi mode, vertical or horizontal take off and landing gyropendular piloted craft or drone with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation capable of moving in the following various physical environments: on land, in the air, in or under the sea or in space, comprising an active pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing which 1) protects the various propulsion units and the payload by absorbing impacts, 2) corrects the trim and reorientates the trajectory upon collisions with any obstacle in the physical environment or the terrain, such a craft being provided with upper, intermediate and lower propulsion units, and with a hollow annular vertebral structure incorporating a payload containing the application functions suited to various domains: 1) civil defence emergency preparedness in the context of search and rescue activities, 2) exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance, 3) detection of deposits of hydrocarbons or ores, of boreholes or pump holes on land, under water or in space, 4) supporting and stabilizing a mobile, free or tethered submerged pontoon for a wind turbine or a water turbine, 5) maintenance work, 6) endovascular or intra-cavity navigation and intravention during surgery, 7) land, aerial, underwater or space telecommunications, and 8) deployment of telecommunications infrastructure in free space.
note: multi-environment craft or drone that also moves under the sea

title: Apparatus for cleaning underwater structures
abstract: Abstract Disclosed herein is an apparatus for cleaning an underwater structure. The apparatus may comprising an inner shell, an outer shell, a plurality of pistons disposed between the inner and outer shells that are configured to translate the inner shell relative to the outer shell such that the apparatus is able to move along the underwater structure, and a cleaning system for cleaning the underwater structure. title: UNMANNED UNDERWATER VEHICLE AND METHOD FOR OPERATING AN UNMANNED UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract: The invention relates to an unmanned underwater vehicle (1) which can be controlled according to predefinable control information by means of a control device (3). The invention also relates to a method for operating an unmanned underwater vehicle (1). To reduce the outlay for investigations of underwater areas using unmanned underwater vehicles, the invention provides for the underwater vehicle (1) to be able to be controlled either in an autonomous operating mode or in a remotely controlled operating mode, predetermined internal control information from a memory element (13) being able to be predefined to the control device (3) in the autonomous operating mode and external control information being able to be predefined to the control device (3) via a communication device (11) of the underwater vehicle (1) in the remotely controlled operating mode.

title: Underwater leading drone system
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for least one leading drone configured to move to a leading drone future location based on a future location of a base station. A set of base station future locations may form a base station path for the base station to traverse. Also, a set of leading drone future locations may form a leading drone path for the leading drone to traverse. The base station's future location may be anticipated from a prediction or a predetermination. The leading drone, navigating along the leading drone path, may collect sensor data and/or perform tasks. The leading drone may interact with sensor drones while traversing the leading drone path. Accordingly, the leading drone may move ahead of the base station in motion, as opposed to following or remaining with the base station.

title: Capturing device of underwater unmanned vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a capturing device of an underwater unmanned vehicle, and relates to the technical field of underwater equipment. Comprising a capturing platform, and a plurality of multi-rigid-body mechanical arms are symmetrically arranged on the capturing platform; the multi-rigid-body mechanical arm comprises a plurality of rigid body units which are sequentially connected, the multi-rigid-body mechanical arm is connected with the capturing platform through a vertical rotating shaft, the rigid body unit, close to one end of the capturing platform, of the multi-rigid-body mechanical arm is a rigid body root unit, one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the bottom of the rigid body root unit, and the other end of the rotating shaft is connected with a hydraulic motor; the hydraulic motor and the rigid body root unit are located on the two sides of the capturing platform correspondingly. The rotating shaft penetrates through the capturing platform and is rotationally matched with the capturing platform. A fixing piece connected with the recycling platform is arranged at the bottom end of the capturing platform. The overall structure is simple, the unmanned underwater vehicle deviating from the axis of the recovery platform is rolled and carried to the capture platform through bending of the multi-rigid-body mechanical arm, and the rolling and carrying actions are simple in the process that the unmanned underwater vehicle is rolled and carried by the multi-rigid-body mechanical arm.

title: Underwater detection mechanical arm capable of carrying contact type detection equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater detection mechanical arm capable of carrying contact type detection equipment, and relates to the technical field of underwater robots. The underwater detection mechanical arm capable of carrying the contact type detection equipment comprises a base, a detection component, and an adjusting arm component. The detection component comprises a seat body, at least one suction assembly used for affixing the seat body onto a detection target through suction and a fixing assembly used for installing the detection equipment on the seat body. Each suction assembly comprises a suction cup used for being affixed onto the detection target through suction. The fixing assembly comprises clamping abutting plates used for clamping the detection equipment. The adjusting arm component comprises a telescopic arm, wherein one end of the telescopic arm is hinged to the base so as to realize the swinging of the telescopic arm, and the seat body of the detection component is hinged to the other end of the telescopic arm so as to realize the swinging of the detection component. The underwater detection mechanical arm capable of carrying the contact type detection equipment achieves contact type detection or observation of the detection target, and the diversity of detection items of the underwater robot is improved.

title: Underwater vehicle recovery device and recovery method
abstract: The invention provides an underwater vehicle recovery device applied to an unmanned ship. The device comprises an unmanned ship end recoverer and an unmanned underwater vehicle end recoverer, whereinthe unmanned ship end recoverer and the unmanned underwater vehicle end recoverer are each provided with a magnet, an unmanned ship end mooring rope is arranged on a side, away from a corresponding magnet, of the unmanned ship end recoverer, an unmanned underwater vehicle end mooring rope is arranged on a side, away from the corresponding magnet, of the unmanned underwater vehicle end recoverer, and a propeller is arranged on a side surface of the unmanned ship end recoverer. The recovery device is advantaged in that an unmanned ship and a micro underwater vehicle release the respective recoverer connected by recovery cables, so positioning and navigation errors can be greatly allowed, when the unmanned underwater vehicle is emergently recovered due to propulsion faults, electronic circuitfaults and the like, the two recoverers are rapidly connected and matched through the electromagnets, the device is more efficient, whether butt joint of the recoverers at the end is successful or not is detected through a pressure sensor and a tension sensor, and the device is more efficient and rapid and has wide applicability in the field of unmanned underwater vehicle recovery.

title: Mechanical arm type launching and retrieval system of underwater robot and launching and retrieval method of mechanical arm type launching and retrieval system
abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical arm type launching and retrieval system of an underwater robot and a launching and retrieval method of the mechanical arm type laying and collecting system. One end of a mechanical arm is detachably mounted on a mother ship, and the upper end of a winding swinging stop mechanism is hinged to the other end of the mechanical arm through a connecting plate A. Oneend of a damping hydraulic cylinder is mounted at the other end of the mechanical arm, the other end of the damping hydraulic cylinder is connected with the connecting plate A, and the winding swinging stop mechanism achieves yaw and trim swinging stop through the damping hydraulic cylinder and is limited and locked through the damping hydraulic cylinder after swinging stop. A rope throwing mechanism for enabling the underwater robot to throw ropes on the sea level is mounted on a bow of the underwater robot, the rope throwing mechanism is provided with a bow throwing-out buoyancy block capable of being released and thrown out, after being released and thrown out, the bow throwing-out buoyancy block drives a rope throwing mooring rope connected to the underwater robot to be unfolded, andthe lower end of the winding swinging stop mechanism is connected with the thrown-out rope throwing mooring rope through a mooring rope. Automatic and less-humanized operation can be achieved, and manpower is liberated to a large degree.

title: Seal arrangement and undersea high-pressure shaft seal cartridge for underwater vehicles
abstract: A sealing arrangement having at least two seals for providing a sealing force against a rotating shaft in underwater applications. A replaceable fin assembly comprising a cartridge and a control fin for manned and unmanned underwater vehicles having the sealing arrangement.
note: borderline: seal for manned and unmanned vehicles

title: Stable diving device and method and underground unmanned underwater vehicle comprising stable driving device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater ordnance and oceaneering and particularly to a stable diving device for an unmanned underwater vehicle. The stable diving device for the unmanned underwater vehicle comprises a motor, a linear sliding rail, a movable ballast, a front photoelectric limiting switch, a rear photoelectric limiting switch and a motor control panel. The motor is connected with the linear sliding rail; the movable ballast is mounted on the linear sliding rail and can slide forth and back on the linear sliding rail; the front end and the rear end of the linear sliding rail are provided with the front photoelectric limiting switch and the rear photoelectric limiting switch respectively; the movable ballast is arranged between the front photoelectric limiting witch and the rear photoelectric limiting switch; the motor, the linear sliding rail and the front photoelectric limiting switch or the rear photoelectric limiting switch compose a closed loop control circuit. The stable diving device for the unmanned underwater vehicle is applicable to solving the problem of design and engineering application of unmanned underwater vehicle stable diving devices; by means of the ballast moving along the axis of the underwater vehicle, adjustment of pitching attitudes of the underwater vehicle can be achieved, and further diving the underwater vehicle at a preset ship speed can be achieved.

title: Underwater robot retractingsystem and application method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot retracting system and an application method thereof. An A-shaped frame can do hinging point pitching movement around the end part of a base through a swinging oil cylinder; a guide frame retracting mechanism comprises a guide frame, and a steel wire rope pulley and a cable guide pulley which are mounted on the guide frame; the top of the guide frame is in rotary connection with a connecting hinge point at the upper part of the A-shaped frame; an adjustable oil cylinder is arranged at each of two ends of the top of the A-shaped frame; the other ends of the adjustable oil cylinders are in rotary connection with the middle part of the guide frame respectively; and the adjustable oil cylinders are retracted to allow the guide frame to rotate around the connecting hinge point at the upper part of the A-shaped frame, so that a cable outlet hole of the guide frame is at a horizontal position all the time. According to the underwater robot retracting system and the application method thereof, disclosed by the invention, the guide frame and the adjustable oil cylinders are used as additional connecting rods and the angle of the guide frame can be adjusted, so that the cable outlet hole of an umbilical cable is at the horizontal position all the time and the umbilical cable can be released accurately along the cable outlet hole.

title: Systems and methods for launching and recovering objects in aquatic environments; platforms for aquatic launch and recovery
abstract: Systems and methods for launching and retrieving payloads in aquatic environments employ a platform that is both floatable and submersible at the discretion of and/or under the control of a user, on which submersible objects to be launched, delivered to a subsea location and/or retrieved (the payload) may be located. The submergible platform has a plurality of sealed and/or sealable buoyancy chambers and at least one low pressure gas storage tank having associated fixtures and valves providing introduction of gas to the buoyancy chambers. One or more buoyant elements may be coupled to the submersible platform to support the platform in a submerged condition. A payload docking system providing secure docking of a payload on the platform deck is also disclosed.
note: borderline: launch and recovery platform

title: Mechanical on-off switch for underwater robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a mechanical on-off switch for an underwater robot. A switch base is installed on the cabin wall of the underwater robot in a sealed mode, a switch knob is in threadedconnection with the interior of one end of the switch base, and a screw pair is formed between one end of the switch knob and the interior of one end of the switch base. The other end of the switch knob is in threaded connection with a conduction copper column insulating part, one end of the conduction copper column is in threaded connection with the conduction copper column insulating part, andthe other end of the conduction copper column is a contact end; and a contact electrode insulating part is in threaded connection with the interior of the other end of the switch base, a plurality ofcontact electrodes which are not conducted in the power-off state are installed on the contact electrode insulating part, one end of each contact electrode defines a space allowing the corresponding conducting copper column to be inserted in, and a welding point used for welding a cable is reserved at the other end of each contact electrode. The mechanical on-off switch is reliable in work, long in service life and convenient to power on and off, can be applied to full sea depth at the maximum depth, and can be widely applied to various underwater robots.

title: Underwater robot used for submarine pipeline connecting installation
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot used for submarine pipeline connecting installation mainly to solve the problems that existing submarine pipeline connection cannot be operated through manpower diving, and the labor intensity of connecting workers is high and the dangerousness is high in the connecting process. The underwater robot used for submarine pipeline connecting installation is characterized in that the underwater robot is mainly composed of a ROV body, a flange connecting machine tool, a buoyancy tank and connecting plates; the ROV body is capable of transferring the flange connecting machine tool to a designated flange connecting position and providing power required for flange connection of the flange connecting machine tool; the flange connecting machine tool comprises a bolt library, a nut library, fixing paws and a connecting frame, and is mainly used for completing flange connection; the buoyancy bank is used for balancing the weight of the flange connecting machine tool in the sea; and the connecting plates can be used for reliably connecting the ROV body with the flange connecting machine tool. By adoption of the underwater robot used for submarine pipeline connecting installation, required mechanical actions can be achieved smoothly, submarine operation by divers is not needed any more, and the operating safety of the workers is guaranteed.

title: MARINE ACOUSTIC RANCH BREEDING METHOD
abstract: The present invention belongs to the field of marine ranches, and particularly relates to a marine acoustic ranch breeding method, including an underwater acoustic robot cluster, an energy supply system and an information transmission system. On the basis of biological hydroacoustic principles, the underwater acoustic robot cluster lures and expels a shoal of fish by means of actively emitting acoustic waves of a particular frequency, and controls the shoal of fish where no marine structure exists. The aims are to realize the migration of a shoal of fish and dispose of the pattern of feeding in a single fixed-point area, so as to realize dynamic fish-farming and fishing in a broader sea area.
note: borderline: underwater acoustic robot cluster

title: Electric power generating submarine tool
abstract: An electric power generating submarine tool is used in the Oil and Gas Industry, for powering submarine equipments applied for combating hydrate and also for feeding electric systems in submarine equipments of production, processing and transporting hydrocarbons. The tool includes a hydraulic engine of axial piston, a mechanical coupling, an electric power generator, an electric box of hydrostatically balanced delivery, a hydrostatically balanced submarine electric cable, a wet-mate-type submarine electric connector, hydraulic hoses, a compensator for allowing equalization of the internal pressure with the external one. The system is interconnected and driven hydraulically by a ROV.
note: oil and gas power tool

title: DATA RETRIEVAL AND TRANSMITTING MARINE EXPLORATION VESSEL SYSTEMS
abstract: A Data Transmitting Marine Vessel System (DRTMEVS) that deploys and provisions the operation of both an aerial visual and data collection drone and an underwater camera and data collection system ROV to gather data at, above, and below the surface of the water simultaneously or individually, or in multiples. The vessel having geodetic and GPS guidance systems that determine the course and actions of the crafts either in a pre-programmed autonomous mode or from a remote operator. The control of the three separate remotely controlled data collection systems and craft are consolidated in the form of a vessel of (DRTMEVS) and monitored via a multitude of possible signals anywhere in the world from a control center.
note: borderline: vessel deploying ROV and aerial drone

title: Dual-mode underwater structure cleaning and detecting robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dual-mode underwater structure cleaning and detecting robot, relates to the technical field of ocean engineering equipment, and solves the common problems that the adaptive capacity to the surface of an ocean structure such as a jacket is limited, and the robot is difficult to adapt to a small-diameter large-curvature pipe pile. The bottom clamping device is rotationally arranged on the buoyancy body, and a first bottom sliding pair is arranged on the bottom clamping device; the number of the bottom clamping action mechanisms is matched with that of the bottom clamping devices, the fixed ends of the bottom clamping action mechanisms are arranged on the buoyancy body, and the movable ends of the bottom clamping action mechanisms are connected to the bottom clamping devices; the pulley pair is arranged on the bottom clamping device capable of being opened and closed, so that the tubular piles with different diameters are matched through opening and closing of the bottom clamping device, and on the basis, by means of the sliding property of the pulley pair, the scheme can smoothly slide along the outer surfaces of the tubular piles, and the scheme has a wider operation range.

title: Underwater robot intelligent control method based on Bayesian deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to an underwater robot intelligent control method based on Bayesian deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, sensing underwater environment information according to a sensor system carried by an underwater robot; s2, constructing an underwater robot Bayesian deep reinforcement learning intelligent control model; s3, completing underwater robot intelligent control model learning according to interactive training; and S4, deploying and applying the underwater robot intelligent control method. According to the invention, the autonomous learning ability of the underwater robot can be endowed, the underwater robot can autonomously complete motion control, and the working efficiency of the underwater robot in underwater operation is improved.

title: Underwater robot carrying multiple functional modules and ecological system of underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot carrying multiple functional modules and an ecological system of underwater robot. The underwater robot comprises an underwater robot shell, a mechanical arm device and a flexible mechanical arm, a connecting rod is installed at the top of the underwater robot shell, and each stable rotary vane is installed at one end of the connecting rod; and advancingrotary vanes are mounted on the two sides of the underwater robot shell correspondingly, and an infrared sensor is mounted at the bottom of the underwater robot shell. According to the underwater robot carrying the multiple functional modules and the ecological system of the underwater robot, through the stable rotary vanes, after the underwater robot is put into water, a motor drives the four stable rotary vanes to rotate so that the underwater robot can ascend and descend underwater, and when the underwater robot ascends and descends to a fixed position, the advancing rotary vanes rotate; and the advancing rotary vanes drive the underwater robot to move in a horizontal direction, meanwhile, the rotating speed of each stable rotary vane can be adjusted through a data chip body accordingto different modules carried by the underwater robot so that the underwater robot is kept balanced.

title: Multifunctional underwater robot device and working method
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional underwater robot device and a working method. The multifunctional underwater robot device comprises a chassis, a collecting box, a buoyancy mechanism and an operation module. The bottom of the chassis is provided with a crawler type walking mechanism, the collecting box is arranged on the chassis, the front portion and the tail portion of the collection box are respectively provided with the operation module and a propulsion mechanism, the operation module is a mechanical arm, which can fulfill multiple functions such as grasping, controlling the position and posture of a suction pipe, and maintenance, the propulsion mechanism is composed of a pair of propellers, which can realize the advancement and steering in the horizontal direction, and meanwhile can generate a low-pressure zone for the collection box to suck in the seabed resources, the buoyancy mechanism comprises a plurality of buoyancy-regulating airbags to realize the active control over the lifting of the device, and thus the multifunctional underwater robot device can perform underwater floating motions and bottom sitting advancing at the same time, the multifunctional underwater robot device can reach the working sea area in the adverse sea condition by itself, to perform diving and floating and submarine operations, so that the operation cycle is shortened, and the operation safety is improved.

title: Collapsible monopole antenna for space-disadvantaged cylindrical platforms
abstract: The system for an antenna assembly for use on unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV). The antennas are low-cost, lightweight, single-use, and have a small form factor amenable to use on a micro-UUV. A central post and pivotally attached arms form an antenna (e.g., a monopole) that is lifted via an aerial, kite, or the like, when deployed from the UUV to extend the line of site of the antenna several meters above the surface of the water. In some cases, the antenna may be used on a number of UUVs in a swarm formation.

title: Unmanned underwater vehicle deploying and retrieving system and deploying and retrieving method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned underwater vehicle deploying and retrieving, and discloses an unmanned underwater vehicle deploying and retrieving system and deploying and retrieving method. The system mainly comprises an unmanned ship control module, a deploying and retrieving device, a snorkeling module, a power module and a ship service information processing module which are arranged on a semi-submersible unmanned ship.
