The ship service information processing module is connected with a navigation positioning module, a target recognition device and a sensor module;the system also comprises a remote monitoring module which is arranged on the ground; the deploying and retrieving device comprises a locking device and an auxiliary clamping device matched with the locking device for use; the locking device can limit horizontal displacement and rotation of the unmanned underwater vehicle, and the auxiliary clamping device can limit vertical sliding of the unmanned underwater vehicle and has higher anti-overturning capacity. The invention solves the problem that in the prior art, when the unmanned underwater vehicle is laid and recovered through a semi-submersible ship, there is no device capable of automatically and rapidly laying and recovering the unmanned underwater vehicle.
note: v1 focal patent

title: Autonomous navigation mechanical arm for underwater operation
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater robots, and particularly relates to an autonomous navigation mechanical arm for underwater operation, which is designed by adopting a modular and reconfigurable thought and comprises a motion propelling module and underwater neutral mechanical arm modules, and the two underwater neutral mechanical arms are arranged on the two sides of the motion propelling module and connected with the motion propelling module through mechanical arm supports; six propellers are arranged on the motion propelling module, so that six-degree-of-freedom propelling can be realized; the underwater mechanical arm achieves underwater neutrality by wrapping a buoyancy material so as to reduce disturbance to the motion propelling module. The underwater operation robot is a new concept underwater operation robot, the operation mode of the underwater operation robot is converted from a submersible vehicle as a core to a mechanical arm as a core, single-hand operation and double-arm collaborative operation can be achieved during operation. Meanwhile, the underwater operation robot and a large-scale operation robot can form a child-mother system to form advantage complementation, and the underwater operation robot is high in practicability. The large-scale operation robot is responsible for large-load tasks, and fine operation is assisted to be carried out.

title: Self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism for AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle)
abstract: The invention discloses a self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism for an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle). The self-locking gravity center adjusting mechanism comprises an eccentric battery pack, an axial adjusting module and a radial adjusting module, the radial adjusting module comprises an annular gear I, an annular gear II, a plurality of connecting rods, a small gear I and a small gear II, wherein the annular gear I and the annular gear II are provided with cross-shaped supporting frame structures, the connecting rods are fixedly connected between the annular gear I and the annular gear II, and the small gear I and the small gear II are connected through a crank I and a crank II respectively and correspondingly meshed with the annular gear I and the annular gear II. The driving self-locking mechanism is used for driving the pinion I to rotate around the axis of the annular gear I; the axial adjusting module comprises an objective table jointly supported by a small worm and a small gear II, a sliding block fixedly provided with the eccentric battery pack and a lead screw nut mechanism used for driving the sliding block to slide in a reciprocating mode in the axial direction. The gravity center adjusting mechanism is compact in structure and modular in design, not only can realize quick adjustment of the gravity center in the axial direction and the radial direction at the same time, but also can realize self-locking, and solves the problems that an existing AUV is poor in maneuverability and low in movement efficiency.

title: Chain-climbing robot for detecting anchor chain of ocean platform
abstract: The invention discloses a chain-climbing robot for detecting an anchor chain of an ocean platform. The chain-climbing robot comprises a box body at the upper part and a counterweight at the lower part, wherein the box body is connected with the counterweight by a connector; the box body is of a rectangular inverted-groove-shaped hollow structure; the box body is internally provided with a lead screw, a lead-screw driving motor, an optical axis, a main detecting device and two electromagnetic clamping devices; the main detecting device is positioned between the two electromagnetic clamping devices and is fixed with the box body by the lead-screw driving motor; lead-screw holes and optical-axis holes are symmetrically arranged at the short edges of the two sides of the box body; the two endsof the lead screw are fixed with the box body by the lead-screw holes; the two ends of the optical axis are fixed with the box body by the optical-axis holes; the lead screw and the optical axis penetrate through the two electromagnetic clamping devices respectively. The chain-climbing robot disclosed by the invention has the characteristics of small volume, simple mechanical structure and low operation cost, the electromagnetic clamping mode has strong adaptability to the shape of the anchor chain, and simultaneously the chain-climbing robot has good safety and can separate by self under emergency so as to recover data.
note: borderline: chain-climbing inspection robot

title: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) multifunctional integrated service platform and formation operation control method
abstract: The invention relates to an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) multifunctional integrated service platform and a formation operation control method. The integrated service platform comprises a double-body ship. A wave energy power generating device is arranged inside the double-body ship. A service platform body is arranged above the double-body ship. A signal base station and an inertia positioning system are arranged on the service platform body. Solar panels are arranged on the left side and the right side of the signal base station. Manipulators are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the signal base station. Wind power generating devices are arranged at the corners of a platform plate. Positioning radars and wireless charging coils are arranged on the edges of the platform plate. Services such as automatic charging, data exchange, instruction send-down and recycling of a plurality of AUVs can be achieved through the service platform, and the butting problem of the AUVs and the platform is solved through sonar with different wave bands.
note: borderline: service platform for AUVs

title: Wind power offshore facility for converting wind energy has a systems mast with maintenance access via an underwater docking station linked to an access ascent shaft
abstract: A systems mast (1) protrudes from the water and has a production unit fitted on it. A foundation pole (7) is let into the seabed. A submarine station is set up for a submarine (8). The systems mast has an ascent shaft (4). The submarine station is designed as a docking station (10) that allows direct access from a docked submarine to the ascent shaft.
note: crewed submarine docking at wind farm

title: Deep sea energy relay system for energy supply of unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a deep sea energy relay system for energy supply of an unmanned underwater vehicle. An underwater on-duty vehicle and an energy supply vehicle are unmanned underwater vehicles. The underwater on-duty vehicle is dispatched by a submarine to perform patrol and detection. The energy supply vehicle is dispatched by the submarine to supply energy to the underwater on-duty vehicle according to the energy stored by the energy supply vehicle. According to the energy stored by a movable charging device and/or the energy transmitted to the movable charging device by a deep sea energy relay station, energy is supplied to the energy supply vehicle moving to the position near the movable charging device. The deep sea energy relay station can generate and store energy and supplyenergy to the movable charging device connected with the deep sea energy relay station. Long-term, autonomous and high-power energy supply to a deep seabed unmanned underwater vehicle can be realized.

title: Submersible remotely operated vehicle
abstract: A submersible ROV is provided with four independently controllable swivel thruster assemblies that allow the submersible ROV to simulate the movement of a person equipped with scuba gear. The submersible ROV receives control signals from a controller located on the surface of the water or on land. The submersible ROV senses and transmits audio and visual images and transmits those signals to a base receiver located on the surface of the water or on land. Signals are transmitted to and from the submersible ROV via a tether. The tether may be connected either directly to the controller/base receiver or may be connected to an intermediate floating ROV with a power supply and wireless communication relay station. A person can vicariously experience scuba diving via the submersible ROV while remaining dry and safe on land or on a surface vehicle.

title: Subsea operations support system
abstract: An underwater operations support system facilitates underwater exploration, monitoring, maintenance and construction operations associated with development of natural resources. The operations support system may include energy generation subsystems, energy accumulation subsystems, communication subsystems, docking stations, repair and maintenance robots, housings for divers, and video subsystems. Supported equipment includes ROVs, HROVs, AUVs, and other autonomous and semi-autonomous mobile robots which move materials, perform manual tasks, and survey the environment. Operational efficiency is enhanced by recharging, repairing and reconfiguring vehicles, and transferring data and commands between vehicles and a control station, without moving the vehicle to and from the surface, and without need for a surface ship to remain on site for the duration of operations.
note: borderline: subsea support system with docking stations

title: System and methods of using unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) along with tethers and tethered devices
abstract: The present invention comprises a plurality of UUVs, tethers and tethered devices. The devices that are tethered comprise explosive devices or acoustic devices. The UUV provides mobility and controllability for the tethers and the tethered devices. The tether is also used as a means to entangle target vessel's propeller. The entangled propeller's revolution moves the explosive device closer to the target vessel for denotation. The tether is made with high strength material whereby once entangled, it is difficult for the propeller itself or intervention to disentangle. The system has a detachable housing with fluid dynamic shape. The whole system is designed to submerge during operation. The system can be wirelessly controlled by a remote command center via satellite link, or by a nearby command center directly.

title: Offshore wind plant operation and maintenance detection system
abstract: The invention provides an operation and maintenance detection system for an offshore wind power plant. The operation and maintenance detection system comprises a control device, an underwater robot, a retractable device and detection equipment, the collecting and releasing device is carried on a working ship, and the collecting and releasing device is connected with the underwater robot and used for releasing the underwater robot to the position below the water surface or collecting the underwater robot to the working ship from the position below the water surface during underwater operation and maintenance detection of the offshore wind plant; the working ship is located on the water surface; the control device is integrated on the working ship, and the control device is connected with the underwater robot; the detection equipment is carried on the underwater robot; the underwater robot comprises an electronic cabin; the detection equipment is connected with the electronic cabin; according to the operation and maintenance detection system for the offshore wind plant, the risk of underwater manual operation is avoided, the underwater robot is adopted to replace a frogman to carry out operation and maintenance, and safety accidents of wind plant operating personnel can be effectively reduced.

title: Intelligent monitor for offshore underwater monitoring
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of marine monitoring equipment, and provides an intelligent monitor for offshore underwater monitoring, which is in communication connection with a ground console, and comprises a detector body, two horizontal propellers arranged on the detector body and used for horizontal displacement of the detector body, and two horizontal propellers arranged on the detector body and used for horizontal displacement of the detector body. The detector comprises a detector body, two vertical propellers used for vertical displacement of the detector body, a monitoring sensing device arranged in the detector body and used for underwater monitoring, a telescopic anchor chain mechanism arranged at the bottom of the detector body and used for parking of the detector body, and an energy supply assembly arranged at the top of the detector body and used for equipment power supply. The intelligent monitor for offshore underwater monitoring has the technical effects that intelligent control can be realized, the cruising ability is high, energy charging is convenient, and the like.

title: Deep ocean water pressure-retention sampling device based on controllable one-way valve cascaded structure
abstract: The invention provides a deep ocean water pressure-retention sampling device based on a controllable one-way valve cascaded structure, which belongs to the field of an ocean technological instrument. Two controllable one-way valves (an electromagnetic one-way valve and a manual one-way valve) are reversely arranged in a pipeline at the front end of a sampling cylinder in serial connection to realize pollution-free sampling, pressure-retention sampling and sample constant-pressure transferring; the way for additionally arranging a pressure compensation cylinder behind a sample cylinder realizes the continuous and mutation-free compensation to the pressure of a sample cavity; a method for filling a space between a sampling piston and a compensation piston with clean seawater and processing a throttling hole in the center of a connection body, pressure-mutation-free sampling is realized; and a one-way valve assembly and a choke plug are installed on an end cover of the compensation cylinder, so that the reliability of the sampling device is improved. All static connection in the sampling device is sealed by virtue of an O-shaped ring end surface, so that the sealing performance of the sampling device is improved. The deep ocean water pressure-retention sampling device is compact in structure, fewer in accessory equipment, simple in a sampling triggering signal and particularly suitable for being equipped with an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) to collect deep ocean water samples.
note: water sampling device

title: Autonomous underwater vehicle multi-fidelity shape optimization method based on data mining
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous underwater vehicle multi-fidelity shape optimization method based on data mining. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a design variablerange, a constraint condition and a target function of shape optimization of an underwater vehicle; secondly, designing sampling to establish high-fidelity and low-fidelity initial agent models, preliminarily updating the low-fidelity agent models by utilizing a method for improving expectation to the maximum extent, and then performing data mining and knowledge extraction on the low-fidelity agent models, so that on one hand, the obtained useful data is added into a high-fidelity database to update the high-fidelity agent models, and on the other hand, the method is used for constructing a local confidence domain and inducing the high-fidelity agent model to enhance the strength of local exploration near the confidence domain, so that the high-fidelity model is quickly converged to a globally optimal solution. And meanwhile, a method of maximizing expectation improvement and a point update high-fidelity agent model are adopted for global exploration, local optimum is avoided, the calculation cost is reduced while the target performance is improved, and the optimization efficiency is improved.

title: Pulse-jet underwater bionic jellyfish robot
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater bionic jet jellyfish robot which comprises a power control part, a power execution part and a balancing device. The power control part is located on the upper portion of the robot and composed of a single-chip microcontroller, a relay, a power source, an air pump set and an air bag. The power execution part is located in the middle of the robot and composed of an upper-layer air cavity and a lower-layer water cavity, the middle-layer air cavity and the lower-layer water cavity are separated through an elastic film, four independent and controllable small water cabins internally provided with small air bags are evenly distributed in the lower-layer water cavity, the small air bags are connected with the air bags in the power control part, and the water amount in the water cabins is controlled through stretching and retracting of the small air bags. Multiple one-way valves are arranged on the side wall and the bottom of the lower-layer water cavity; the balancing device is composed of a fin and a tail pendulum which are located on the side portion and the bottom edge of the lower-layer water cavity respectively. Under the control of the single-chip microcomputer, water absorption and water spraying can be achieved, so that axial accelerated movement, hovering, sinking and floating in water, rapid steering and other movement are executed. The robot has the advantages of being good in flexibility, simple in structure, high in expansibility and the like.

title: SUBMERSIBLE VESSEL HAVING RETRACTABLE WING AND KEEL ASSEMBLIES
abstract: A submersible vessel (10) having wing (14) and keel (16) assemblies that are extendable for wind-powered surface operation and retractable to reduce drag for submerged operation or to place the vessel in a more compact configuration. The vessel may have first (52a) and second (52b) pressure hulls flanking the wing and keel assemblies. A deployment mechanism (60) including an actuator (62) and linkage pivots the wing and keel assemblies simultaneously between the deployed configuration in which the wing and keel assemblies extend outwardly above and below the hull assembly for wind-powered surfaced operation of the vessel and a retracted configuration in which the wing and the keel assemblies are angled back towards the hull assembly to reduce drag for submerged operation.
note: submersible vessel; crew not stated

title: AUV long-term residence system based on marine environment energy
abstract: The invention relates to an AUV long-term residence system based on marine environment energy. The system comprises a water surface energy obtaining and communication unit, an underwater energy storage and adaptation unit and an underwater docking platform, wherein the water surface energy obtaining and communication unit receives an energy obtaining instruction of a remote monitoring center, is connected with the underwater energy storage and adaptation unit through a photoelectric composite cable, transmits the obtained energy to the underwater energy storage and adaptation unit, and communicates with the underwater energy storage and adaptation unit; the underwater energy storage and adaptation unit supplies power to the underwater docking platform and communicates with the underwater docking platform; the underwater docking platform is used for being in communication connection with the AUV through short-distance radio communication when the underwater docking platform is in a docking state with the AUV, and supplementing energy to the AUV through a wireless charging device; and when being separated from the AUV, the underwater docking platform is in communication connection with the AUV through underwater acoustic communication. The system can work in an unattended mode for a long time, and the system operates independently, autonomously and efficiently; and meanwhile, clean energy in the marine environment is continuously obtained, so that the system is more environment-friendly.

title: Robotic submersible cleaning system
abstract: A cleaning system includes a chassis supporting a propulsion system for propelling the cleaning system across a surface. At least one sensor of a first type is coupled to the chassis, and a surface engagement mechanism is configured to maintain the cleaning system coupled to the surface as the propulsion system propels the cleaning system across the surface. A cleaning device is coupled to the chassis and configured to abrade the fouling from the surface, and a controller coupled to the chassis and in signal communication with the propulsion system and the first sensor. The controller is configured to receive a signal from the at least one sensor of the first type and control the propulsion system in response to the signal.
note: borderline: submersible cleaning robot, application not stated

title: FLOW RESISTANCE REDUCING STRUCTURE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide flow resistance reducing structure to be used for a fluid contact surface of a mobile body such as a vessel, an underwater robot, a submarine, an aircraft, a railway vehicle and an automobile, a rotor such as a propeller and a wind power generation blade or the like, and a swimwear, and exhibiting a flow resistance reducing effect by forming a surface flow into a laminar flow to stabilize a fluid flow not only in a laminar flow area wherein the flow speed is relatively small but also in a turbulent flow area wherein the flow speed is large.

SOLUTION: This flow resistance reducing structure comprises a plurality of protruding parts 3 formed with a space from each other in a fluid contact surface 2 of an article, and a plurality of protruding line parts 5 formed in nearly parallel with each other on the top surface 4 of the protruding part 3.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
note: generic drag-reduction surface

title: REMOTELY OPERATED VEHICLE FOR AN AUTOMATED STORAGE AND RETRIEVAL SYSTEM
abstract: A remotely operated vehicle for an automated storage and retrieval system moves a product item between a storage container stored in an automated storage and retrieval grid configured to store a plurality of stacks of storage containers, and a further container. The remotely operated vehicle includes a vehicle body; a wheel arrangement connected to the vehicle body configured to move the remotely operated vehicle along a rail system of the automated storage and retrieval system; and a picking system for moving the product item between the storage container and the further container. The vehicle includes a container lifting device configured to carry the further container. The picking system includes a picking arm having a first end connected to the vehicle body and a second end. The picking system includes a holding mechanism for releasably holding of the product item. The holding mechanism is provided in the second end of the picking arm.
note: warehouse robot: "remotely operated vehicle" false positive

title: Vibration absorbing type underwater four-foot wall-climbing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a vibration absorbing type underwater four-foot wall-climbing robot. The robot comprises a body part and mechanical legs which are separately arranged at both sides of the body part in a row. The robot further comprises a control system for controlling the work of the mechanical leg, every mechanical leg comprises a leg assembly and a vibration absorbing device arranged at the tail end of the leg assembly; the leg assembly comprises a base body, a thigh, a shank and a tail leg; the base body is matched with the body part in the manner of rotating in a cross plane, and the thigh is matched with the base body in the manner of rotating in a vertical plane; the shank is matched with the thigh in the manner of rotating in the vertical plane, and the tail leg is matched with the shank in the manner of rotating in the vertical plane; the vibration absorbing device can be matched with the tail leg in the manner of rotating around own axial line. The vibration absorbing type underwater four-foot wall-climbing robot has high bionic effect and can realize the barrier-free movement in multiple directions, improve the movement performance of the underwater robot, and greatly improve the working efficiency of the underwater robot.

title: Unmanned ship and system
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned ship and a system. The unmanned ship comprises an image acquiring module, a sonar detection module, a communication module and a central controller, wherein the image acquiring module is used for recording and shooting an underwater image; the sonar detection module is used for detecting the underwater environment as well as the position and the depth of fish school; the communication module is used for transmitting state information about the unmanned ship, image information acquired by the image acquiring module and information acquired by the sonar detection module to an external terminal and transmitting a control instruction of the external terminal to the central controller at the same time; the central controller is connected with the modules, controls advancing motion of the unmanned ship and coordinates operation of all the modules. The unmanned ship has the function of an existing unmanned fishing boat and can also dive for certain depth, realize telecommunication with the shore and transmit underwater image information back in real time.
note: unmanned surface ship

title: Autonomous power generation in submersible environments
abstract: Embodiments provide for safely and reliably operating a generator in a submersible environment utilizing an autonomous control system. One embodiment is a power generation system that includes a generator, a water-tight enclosure surrounding the generator, an intake valve, an exhaust valve, and a controller. The intake valve couples an air intake on the generator to an outside surface of the enclosure. The exhaust valve couples an exhaust port on the generator to the outside surface. If the controller determines that the enclosure will submerge, then the controller stops the generator and closes the intake valve and the exhaust valve. After detecting that the enclosure has surfaced, the controller opens the intake valve, opens the exhaust valve, and starts the generator.
note: borderline: generator enclosure, not a vehicle

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR UNDERWATER DEPLOYMENT OF A PAYLOAD
abstract: A system and method for safely, efficiently and reliably deploying a payload, such as a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) beneath the surface of the water. The ROV is configured to capture data and/or information and to transmit the data and/or information to a base station. The system comprises an unmanned aerial system (UAS) having a frame comprising a support structure configured to receive the payload, wherein the payload may be deployed beneath the surface of water and a winch is configured to deploy the ROV from and retrieve the ROV back to the UAS using a tether. The tether is configured to wirelessly transmit telemetry, data, and/or information between the UAS and the ROV in real time.
note: ROV deployed by aerial drone

title: Dry-type cabin skid structure suitable for multi-cylinder foundation sinking and pipeline system
abstract: The invention discloses a dry-type cabin skid structure suitable for multi-cylinder foundation sinking and a pipeline system. The dry-type cabin skid structure suitable for multi-cylinder foundation sinking comprises a multi-cylinder foundation and a dry-type cabin skid; the multi-cylinder foundation comprises three hollow cylinder bodies with openings in the bottoms; the multi-cylinder foundation is used for carrying out mud penetrating operation on a seabed under the action of self weight when the multi-cylinder foundation is put into seawater; the dry-type cabin skid is arranged at the top of the multi-cylinder foundation; and the dry-type cabin skid is in communication with the internal space of each cylinder body through a water pipeline, and is used for pumping out water in each cylinder body in the multi-cylinder foundation when the cylinder body completes the mud penetrating operation of the seabed under the action of self weight, so that negative pressure is generated in the multi-cylinder foundation, and the multi-cylinder foundation gradually sinks until each cylinder body goes deep into the seabed to reach a preset depth. With safety, high efficiency and low cost as targets, the dry-type cabin skid structure is adopted to replace an existing underwater robot structure high in manufacturing cost, the multi-cylinder foundation sinking installation cost is greatly reduced, and it is guaranteed that the multi-cylinder foundation is smoothly installed in place.
note: foundation structure

title: AUV intelligent operation and maintenance system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance system and method for an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle), and belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance. The hardware system comprises a propulsion information monitoring subsystem, an environment information monitoring subsystem, a corrosion information monitoring subsystem, an energy monitoring subsystem, a task module subsystem, a buoy, a shipborne intelligent operation and maintenance subsystem, a base station and a shore-end intelligent operation and maintenance subsystem; the method comprises the steps of real-time data collection, collected data processing and analysis, state recognition, operation and maintenance work development, result feedback and updating of technical data of all modules. By adopting the system and the method provided by the invention, the AUV sensor data is analyzed, the residual life of the AUV is predicted and calculated, the normal underwater operation of the AUV is ensured to the greatest extent, and the economic loss is reduced.

title: Modular mechanical arm for adaptive cleaning and damage detection of underwater pile foundation
abstract: A modular mechanical arm of an underwater pile foundation structure includes a modular interface disposed at one end of the transmission arm rod, a mechanical arm connecting part disposed at the other end of the transmission arm rod. The mechanical arm connecting part is separately provided with two arm frames, each of the arm frames comprises an inner arm frame and an outer arm frame, the inner arm frame and the outer arm frame are coupled by a joint, and a soft moving and cleaning part is disposed on an inner side of each of the arm frames; the modular interface is coupled with an underwater UAV interface to transmit current and a control signal, a waterproof steering gear is built in the transmission arm rod to receive the control signal.
note: borderline: arm for underwater pile cleaning, likely ROV-mounted

title: Sliding-mode control method for parameter-free driving-insufficient UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) vertical plane route tracking
abstract: The invention provides a sliding-mode control method for parameter-free driving-insufficient UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) vertical plane route tracking. The sliding-mode control method comprises the following steps: I, performing initialization; II, acquiring a current state of a UUV; III, establishing an error equation of the horizontal plane of the driving-free UUV so as to obtain position deviation values xe and ze and course deviation value theta e; IV, according to a sliding-mode control method, respectively designing traveling speed sliding-mode self-adaptive control rules, position sliding-mode control rules and trimming angle sliding-mode self-adaptive control rules, controlling propelling force Xprop, an excepted traveling speed U and a torque Mprop, wherein eu is 0, xe is 0 and theta e is 0; V, designing fuzzy control rules for a boundary layer, setting k to be equal to k+1, turning to step II, and updating control rules and self-adaptive rules of a next time. By adopting the sliding-mode control method, a controller for stabilizing a system can be designed only according to a vertical surface kinetic model, self-adaptive rules can be designed for water kinetic parameters with uncertainties, furthermore a control system can be relieved from dependency on parameters, the system has robustness, and the influence of the uncertainties on the sliding-mode control approaching process can be reduced.
note: v1 focal patent

title: Multi-wire system high-voltage power supply system for remote underwater operated vehicle
abstract: In order to solve the problem that an underwater robot power supply system is too large in size and weight, the invention provides a multi-wire system high-voltage power supply system for a remote underwater operated vehicle. The power supply system includes: a first AC/DC converter; a second AC/DC converter, wherein the positive output end of the second AC/DC converter is connected with the negative output end of the first AC/DC converter; a first power transmission line connected with the positive output end of the first AC/DC converter; a second power transmission line connected with the negative output end of the first AC/DC converter; and a third power transmission line connected with the negative output end of the second AC/DC converter. Compared with the prior art, the power supply system provided by the invention can effectively reduce the size and weight.
note: ROV power supply

title: Folding underwater charging platform and use method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a folding underwater charging platform and a use method thereof, the folding underwater charging platform comprises an underwater platform, and the outer wall surface of the underwater platform is provided with an accommodating cabin for installing the charging platform; the charging platform comprises a main body support fixedly mounted at the bottom of the accommodating cabin, a lifting support is slidably mounted on the main body support, and the lifting support is driven by a power assembly to move towards a cabin opening of the accommodating cabin relative to the main body support; a charging main board is installed at the top end of the lifting support through a rotating assembly, and the charging main board is overturned to be attached or unfolded relative to the lifting support through the action of a main hydraulic rod. Charging sub-plates are rotationally mounted on the two sides of the charging main plate, and the charging sub-plates are perpendicularly arranged relative to the charging main plate or located in the same plane through the action of the sub-hydraulic rods; during charging, the charging platform extends outwards from the interior of the containing cabin and is unfolded out of the outboard of the underwater platform, underwater parking, butt joint and wireless charging of charging objects such as AUV formation are facilitated, underwater energy charging of multiple objects can be met, and the cruising ability of the underwater charging platform is greatly improved.
note: borderline: underwater charging platform, vehicle not stated

title: Variable structure robot based on Bernoulli sucker
abstract: The invention relates to a variable structure robot based on a Bernoulli sucker, and belongs to the technical field of underwater robots. The robot comprises a robot body and a Bernoulli sucker arranged on the robot body. A front mechanical arm and a rear mechanical arm are arranged on the two sides of the machine body correspondingly, and Bernoulli suckers are installed on the front mechanical arm and the rear mechanical arm; the front mechanical arm comprises a front upper arm, a front lower arm, a first driver for driving the front upper arm to rotate around the Y axis, and a second driverfor driving the front lower arm to rotate around the X axis; the Bernoulli sucker is movably mounted on the front lower arm in a manner of rotating around a Z axis; the rear mechanical arm comprises arear upper arm and a third driver for driving the rear upper arm to rotate around the X axis; and the Bernoulli sucker is movably mounted on the rear upper arm in a manner of rotating around the Z axis. The variable structure of the robot is achieved through the freedom degrees of the front mechanical arm and the rear mechanical arm, and the robot can adapt to different working states. And meanwhile, in combination with the Bernoulli sucker interval propelling and adsorbing functions, dual modes of cruise and wall climbing of the robot can be switched, and the redundancy of the overall structure is reduced.

title: Systems and methods for launching and retrieving objects in aquatic environments; platforms for aquatic launch and retrieval
abstract: Systems and methods for launching and retrieving payloads in aquatic environments employ a platform that is both floatable and submersible at the discretion of and/or under the control of a user, on which submersible objects to be launched, delivered to a subsea location and/or retrieved (the payload) may be located. The platform is generally maneuvered to a desired site in a buoyant, floating state and is submerged, with the payload coupled to the platform, at the desired site. One or more buoyant elements is coupled to the submersible platform by cable(s), line(s), chain(s) or other coupling mechanisms. When the platform is submerged, the one or more floatable element(s) remain at or in proximity to the sea surface and support the platform in a submerged condition. The platform has a relatively large mass and, when submerged, acts as a dampener, while the buoyant element(s) and associated line(s)/cable(s)/coupling mechanism(s) act, relative to the submerged platform, as classic spring.
note: borderline: launch and recovery platform for submersibles

title: Offshore wind power pile foundation scouring detection method and system based on underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an offshore wind power pile foundation scouring detection method and system based on an underwater robot, and the method comprises the steps: determining a to-be-detected region, determining a plurality of scanning regions, including an outer ring region and an inner ring region, firstly building the outer ring region, setting the inner ring region when the plurality of outer ring regions cannot cover all detection regions, and setting the inner ring region when the plurality of outer ring regions cannot cover all detection regions; it is ensured that the whole to-be-detected area can be covered; and then a robot is put, and after the robot scans in each scanning area through a mechanical scanning sonar module, a scour image is finally obtained.
note: method using underwater robot

title: Autonomous maritime container system
abstract: An apparatus, method and system for utilizing commercial cargo containers is disclosed. The present invention utilizes containers made autonomous by coupling a container with a detachable propulsion system, having a motor and navigation and steering controls, permitting the rapid, controlled, efficient and safe delivery of cargo containers individually by water. Ballast units, deployment systems and control via remote units are also disclosed. The containers, utilizing their inherent buoyancy, can move autonomously according to a preplanned or remote controlled route to a specific location.
note: autonomous surface containers

title: Autonomous ROVs with offshore power source that can return to recharge
abstract: A resident remotely operated vehicle may be deployed subsea by deploying a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) (200) configured to be disposed and remain resident subsea for an extended time where the ROV comprises an ROV electrical power connector port (202) to be operatively connected to an electrical power supply (700) dedicated to the ROV. An RTMS configured to be disposed subsea for an extended time is also deployed subsea (210), typically proximate the ROV. A subsea docking hub subsea is also deployed subsea proximate the RTMS and operatively connected to the ROV and the RTMS. In addition, an umbilical is connected from the subsea docking hub to a subsea structure and a signal supplied from the subsea structure to the ROV.
note: v1 focal patent

title: METHOD FOR INSTALLING A SUBSEA CABLE
abstract: An assembly (400) for installing a subsea cable (304), the assembly comprising a submersible apparatus (200) and a submersible cable holder (300) comprising the subsea cable, the subsea cable being connectable to the submersible apparatus through a connector (202) for transmission of electric power and/or data to the submersible apparatus; wherein the assembly is configured to install the subsea cable while the submersible apparatus is electrically powered through said subsea cable. And a method for installing a subsea cable (304) with a submersible apparatus (200), the method comprising: supplying electric power and/or transmitting data through the subsea cable to the submersible apparatus; and laying the subsea cable in a sea with the submersible apparatus.
note: borderline: submersible apparatus installing cable

title: Efficient operation equipment and method for realizing lowering and inter-well moving of blowout preventer stack without guide rope
abstract: The invention relates to efficient operation equipment and method for realizing lowering and inter-well moving of a blowout preventer stack without a guide rope, and belongs to the field of ocean deepwater oil and gas drilling. The equipment comprises a platform system and an underwater system; the platform system comprises a deepwater semi-submersible drilling platform, a propeller, a driller panel, a leader panel, an information control terminal, a platform crane, and a platform power positioning system; and the underwater system comprises a riser system, a blowout preventer stack, a sound wave emitter, a quick connector, a conduit head, a seabed wellhead and an underwater robot. Under the condition that a drilling template and a permanent guide base plate are installed, the blowout preventer stack can be rapidly lowered under the condition that no guide rope exists and is accurately aligned at the permanent guide base plate; and after the next drilling operation is completed, the optimal lifting depth for inter-well moving of the blowout preventer stack is determined through sea area operation risk analysis, and then the moving path of the blowout preventer stack is optimized bycombining the sound wave emitter and a sound wave transponder, so that efficient movement of the blowout preventer stack is realized.
note: drilling BOP equipment

title: Rapid laying robot for submarine cable of ocean wind power plant
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean wind power plant seabed submarine cable rapid laying robot which comprises a robot body, a buoyancy adjusting mechanism used for controlling the robot body to float up and down is arranged above the robot body, and a grooving mechanism used for penetrating into silt to form a groove is arranged on the advancing side of the robot body. A laying mechanism used for laying submarine cables in a groove is arranged in the middle of the robot body, a burying mechanism used for burying silt in the submarine cables in the groove is arranged on the rear side of the robot body, and a crawler walking mechanism is arranged below the robot body. The robot body is further provided with a propelling mechanism used for providing power for the robot body. The rapid laying robot for the submarine cable of the ocean wind power plant is complete in function, the robot can achieve grooving, laying and burying work, the working time is greatly shortened, the working efficiency and safety are improved, and practicability is higher.

title: Self-generating underwater detection robot based on oscillating floating and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a self-generating underwater detection robot based on oscillating floating and an application. The underwater detection robot comprises an energy supply device and an underwater detection robot, wherein, the energy supply device comprises an oscillation part, an energy transmission part and a power generation part connected from top to bottom in turn; the oscillation partmoves under the impact of ocean waves and drives the power generation part to carry out power generation operation through the energy transmission part; the underwater detection robot comprises a protection part, a coupling fixing part and a walking foot connected from top to bottom in turn; the bottom of the power generation part is connected with the coupling fixing part through a cable and supports and protects the whole energy supply device through the protection part, and the power generation part provides the required power for the operation of the underwater detection robot; and as theunderwater detection robot can generate power automatically by utilizing wave energy, no additional power supply is required, and the design is more advanced and intelligent, thereby providing powerful guarantee for the long-term deep-sea operation of the underwater detection robot.

title: ENERGY SUPPLY VESSEL AND ENERGY SUPPLY METHOD USING SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to an energy supply vessel and an energy supply method using same, the energy supply vessel comprising: a hull; an electricity storage device for storing electricity at the hull; a charging port provided at the hull for an electrical connection with an external electricity supply target using electricity as a power source, so as to charge the electricity supply target with the electricity supplied from the electricity storage device; a communication unit provided at the hull so as to allow communication with the electricity supply target; a propeller for generating a propulsive force such that the hull moves for the electrical connection with the electricity supply target; and a control unit for controlling the electricity storage device, the charging port, the communication unit, and the propeller according to an operation signal of an operation unit or a determined process. According to the present invention, electricity can be easily supplied to an electric propulsion ship, an underwater drone, a water drone, an air drone, an electric vehicle, and other various electricity supply targets using electricity as a power source on the water, under the water, or near the water, or a battery can be replaced and, furthermore, a battery in a floatel can be charged, or the energy supply vessel can be used as an uninterruptible power supply device for a floatel, a waterside hotel, or the like. Therefore, the present invention can guarantee stable on-the-water and waterside charging conditions, movement, and electricity use of an electricity supply target using electricity as a power source, quickly and conveniently supply electricity to the electricity supply target using electricity as a power source, at any time and at a desired place, and contribute to the recycling of rapidly increasing electric vehicle water batteries.
note: surface energy vessel

title: Omni-directional floating and wall-climbing underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an omni-directional floating and wall-climbing underwater robot. The omni-directional floating and wall-climbing underwater robot comprises a sealed cabin, an underwater high-definition camera, a main control module, underwater sensing equipment, an omni-directional power system and a vertical power system, wherein the underwater sensing equipment is arranged inside and outside the cabin; the omni-directional power system and the vertical power system are arranged inside and outside the cabin; the omni-directional power system comprises four shrouded propellers, shrouded propeller steering devices, climbing devices and floating devices; the floating devices are arranged in the cabin; one end of each floating device is connected with the corresponding shrouded propeller; the shrouded propeller steering devices and the climbing devices are divided into upper and lower layers, are respectively arranged in the cabin and are connected with each other through respective transmission devices; the vertical power system is vertically arranged inside the cabin. The omni-directional floating and wall-climbing underwater robot has functions of floating, adsorption, wall-climbing and underwater monitoring, is flexible to move, high in practicality, high in maneuverability and wide in application range, can be used for omni-directional floating operation or omni-directional wall-climbing operation, is suitable for working in a narrow water area, and is compact in structure and convenient and easy to operate; the manufacturing cost is reduced; the accuracy of floating movement is improved.

title: Overwater floating equipment platform
abstract: The invention discloses an overwater floating equipment platform. The overwater floating equipment platform comprises a No.1 ballast tank, a No.2 ballast tank, a No.3 ballast tank, a No.4 ballast tank, a propulsion tank, a No.6 ballast tank, a wave energy power generation tank and a multilayer deck from head to tail. The No.2 ballast tank is divided into a No.2 top ballast tank and a No.2 bottom ballast tank. The No.3 ballast tank is divided into a No.3 top ballast tank, a No.3 bottom ballast tank, a No.3 left ballast tank and a No.3 right ballast tank. A propelling device is arranged in the propelling tank. The propelling device comprises a tunnel type propeller, a telescopic propeller and a battery pack. A wave energy power generation device is arranged in the wave energy power generation tank and comprises a piston rod, a vibrator and a hydraulic cylinder. According to the invention, a propulsion mode of combining the electrically-driven tunnel propeller and the telescopic propelleris adopted, autonomous navigation can be realized, interference of the propellers to experiments can be effectively avoided, and a plurality of ballast tanks are arranged, so that ship rotation operation can be realized more stably.
note: floating platform

title: HYDROKINETIC ENERGY TRANSFER DEVICE AND METHOD
abstract: A device 2 configured for the production of hydrokinetic energy that allows the efficient capture of energy from fluid in motion, especially slow flowing fluids. The device features a drive train system having redundancy, The device 2 features one or more turbines 4, each turbine 4 having an open center tube 20. The device 2 features a buoyancy system 160 including a plurality of thin walled modular buoyancy chambers 12, 120, 170 with a redundant (re)pressurization system and remotely operated vehicle replaceable bladder modules 122, 132. Cavities of the device are capable of storing energy via processed energy storage liquids or gasses and then exporting the stored energy or reconverting the stored energy into electricity.
note: energy device

title: Underwater robot for underwater detection in offshore wind power single pile
abstract: The underwater robot for underwater detection in the offshore wind power single pile comprises an underwater detection mechanism, underwater power driving mechanisms and an annular anti-collision buffering protection plate, and the underwater power driving mechanisms are evenly distributed in the circumferential direction of the underwater detection mechanism; the free ends of the multiple underwater power driving mechanisms are all connected to the annular anti-collision buffering protection plate. The device can realize the function of vertical lifting detection underwater, can enter a vertical narrow channel, can efficiently complete underwater detection in an offshore wind power single pile, and is convenient for workers to carry out underwater detection.

title: Series hybrid architecture for an unmanned underwater vehicle propulsion system
abstract: A propulsion system for an unmanned underwater vehicle includes a turbine engine, a generator mechanically coupled to an output shaft of the turbine engine, an electrical motor mechanically decoupled from the turbine engine and electrically coupled to the generator via a power bus architecture, and a propulsor mechanically coupled to a rotational output of the electrical motor. The power bus architecture includes a pair of AC buses and a DC bus.

title: ROV bait casting robot
abstract: The invention discloses an ROV bait casting robot. The ROV bait casting robot comprises a spherical bait device and an underwater vehicle, wherein the spherical bait device and the underwater vehicleare connected together; the spherical bait device comprises a ship body shell and a circular hopper; the circular hopper is installed in the ship body shell; an outer cover is fixedly installed abovethe ship body shell; the upper end of the circular hopper is fixedly connected with the outer cover; a cover is fixedly installed above the circular hopper; a supporting frame is installed at the bottom in the ship body shell; a framework is fixedly installed on the supporting frame; the circular hopper is clamped to the framework; a feeding pipe is inserted into the ship body shell; a screw rod is rotationally installed in the feeding pipe; and a motor bracket is fixedly mounted on one side of the supporting frame. The invention relates to the technical field of aquaculture, and the device can enable a farmer to operate and control a feeding robot at home at any time, in an office space or any culture area, and achieves the all-weather seamless connection.

title: Semi-submersible unmanned submersible vehicle intelligent power supply management system and method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of semi-submersible unmanned underwater vehicles, and particularly relates to a semi-submersible unmanned submersible vehicle intelligent power supply management system and method. According to the invention, the semi-submersible unmanned submersible vehicle intelligent power supply management system is combined with program software, on the premise ofguaranteeing long-time endurance, a solar cell or a lithium battery pack is automatically selected as a main power supply for configuration, the electric quantity condition of the lithium battery packcan be monitored, and the battery pack with sufficient electric quantity is automatically switched under the condition that the electric quantity of a certain battery pack is exhausted. Power switching is carried out through an upper computer in severe weather, and a super capacitor is used for providing extra power compensation for the system; the semi-submersible unmanned submersible vehicle intelligent power supply management system has a remote monitoring function, an operator can realize whole-process management of a power supply system without being on site, a more flexible space is provided for the operator, and the operation safety of the semi-submersible unmanned submersible vehicle is greatly improved.
note: borderline: semi-submersible unmanned vehicle

title: Floating and sinking mechanism of bionic robot fish
abstract: The invention discloses a floating and sinking mechanism of a bionic robot fish. The floating and sinking mechanism of the bionic robot fish comprises a first water storage and drainage tank, a second water storage and drainage tank, a gas storage tank and an air pump, wherein the first water storage and drainage tank is used for controlling a fish head to float and sink, the second water storage and drainage tank is used for controlling a fish body to float and sink, the gas storage tank is connected with the first water storage and drainage tank and the second water storage and drainage tank, and the air pump is used for controlling gas exchange to be conducted between the gas storage tank and the second water storage and drainage tank as well as between the gas storage tank and the first water storage and drainage tank; and the first water storage and drainage tank is mounted on the front portion of the fish body, and the second water storage and drainage tank is mounted on the middle portion of the fish body. According to the floating and sinking mechanism of the bionic robot fish, the first water storage and drainage tank and the second water storage and drainage tank are arranged on the front portion and the middle portion of the fish body and connected with the gas storage tank, and gas delivery between the gas storage tank and the first water storage and drainage tank as well as between the gas storage tank and the second water storage and drainage tank is controlled through the air pump, so that water storage and drainage of the first water storage and drainage tank and the second water storage and drainage tank are achieved, and floating and sinking of the fish body and the fish head of the bionic robot fish are achieved accordingly; and the structure is simple.

title: Seaborne detection robot driven by both wave energy and wind energy
abstract: The invention relates to a seaborne detection robot which comprises a waterborne floating body device, a middle connecting device and a power driving device. The waterborne floating body device adopts a ship-shaped structure, stabilization bodies, an airtight cabin, a solar cell panel, a GPS, a communication antenna and a sensor are arranged on the waterborne floating body device, and the airtight cabin is internally provided with a storage battery and a communication controller; the middle connecting device is a flexible cable made from special materials and can transmit electric energy, signals and kinetic energy; and the power driving device comprises a wind energy driving assembly and a wave energy driving assembly. According to the seaborne detection robot driven by both wave energy and wind energy, the purpose of making the seaborne detection robot to sail along a preset track is achieved by jointly utilizing renewable sources of wave energy and wind energy as direct driving force, an underwater glider driven by wave energy as active power to pull the waterborne floating body device to move forward underwater and thrust generated by a propeller driven by wind energy as auxiliary power and automatic cruise control of the communication controller.
note: wave-driven detection robot with a submerged propulsion unit

title: Overwater carrier
abstract: An overwater carrier is used for carrying observation equipment to make the observation equipment float on water, and comprises a connecting and protecting assembly, a battery cabin assembly, a buoyancy material and a control cabin assembly which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the connecting and protecting assembly is located at the lowermost end, and is used for hanging the observation equipment under the water surface and providing a protection effect for the observation equipment, the upper end of the connecting and protecting assembly is connected with the battery cabin assembly, the battery cabin assembly is used for providing a power supply for the observation equipment and the control cabin assembly, the upper end of the battery cabin assembly is connected with the buoyancy material, and the control cabin assembly is arranged at the upper part of the buoyancy material. The overwater carrier is simple and compact in structure, can provide buoyancy for the observation equipment, can well protect the observation equipment, is high in structural reliability and good in durability, and enables the working performance of the whole equipment to be more stable and reliable. The overwater carrier is simple and compact in structure, small in size and low in manufacturing cost.
note: floating carrier

title: Spring type automatic locking device for underwater control module
abstract: The invention provides a spring type automatic locking device for an underwater control module. The spring type automatic locking device mainly comprises a ring, a guide sleeve, a center shaft, a support column, an inner locking sleeve, a fixed cover, a lock core, a sliding block, a locking spring, a return spring an outer locking sleeve and a guide head and is used for butt joint, locking and unlocking of an upper connection disc and a lower connection disc of the underwater control module. After butt joint, the ring is released, automatic locking is achieved under the action of the locking spring and the return spring, and thus breakover of the underwater control module with electric and liquid functional elements and the like of underwater production equipment in an inserting-connecting mode is achieved, and the positions of all the functional elements are kept fixed. When the underwater control module needs maintenance and replacement, automatic unlocking can be achieved by pulling the ring directly through a manipulator on an ROV. The difficult technical problems of too long consumed time and difficult locking of the operation process when locking and unlocking are conducted by a torque tool through the ROV. The spring type automatic locking device is compact in inner structure and suitable for operation in a deepwater environment, and the butt joint, locking and unlocking efficiency is improved significantly.
note: oil and gas subsea control module

title: UNMANNED SURFACE VESSEL FOR REMOTELY OPERATED UNDERWATER VEHICLE OPERATIONS
abstract: The invention relates to an unmanned surface vessel for remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) operations, comprising an ROV, a deployment and recovery device to deploy an ROV from the vessel to water and recover the ROV from the water to the vessel, and a vessel control unit controlling the deployment and recovery of the ROV, the operation of the ROV, and movements of the vessel.
note: borderline: surface vessel for ROV operations (hybrid)

title: Underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot, which comprises a robot body of a frame structure and a hover control device arranged in the robot body. The robot body comprises a first vertical beam anda second vertical beam which are arranged oppositely; the hover control device comprises pull lines, a line winding shaft, a first damping sheet and a second damping sheet, wherein the first dampingsheet and the second damping sheet can be wound automatically; and the line winding shaft is rotatably mounted between the first vertical beam and the second vertical beam, the first damping sheet andthe second damping sheet are mounted on the first vertical beam and the second vertical beam in a wounded mode correspondingly, and the extending-out ends of the first damping sheet and the second damping sheet are both connected with the line winding shaft through the pull lines. According to the underwater robot, disturbance to a surrounding water body is small when a damping sheet extending and retracting device works, the problem of a floating plume flow formed by a propeller is avoided, thus the definition of an observation view is increased significantly, and the visible range of the observation view is enlarged significantly.

title: Active flow control system for wing body integrated underwater glider
abstract: The invention discloses an active flow control system for a wing body integrated underwater glider, and relates to the field of flow control. The system comprises an electromagnetic flow control actuator unit installed at the front end of the upper surface of an underwater glider wing, and steady jet flow openings and synthetic jet flow openings are alternately formed in the position, where the electromagnetic flow control actuator unit is installed, of the upper surface of the underwater glider wing in sequence; a steady jet flow control actuator unit is arranged below the steady jet flow port, and a synthetic jet flow control actuator unit is arranged below the synthetic jet flow port; and the electromagnetic flow control actuator unit, the steady jet flow control actuator unit and the synthetic jet flow control actuator unit are respectively connected with a signal processing and control system, the signal processing and control system is connected with a sensor, and the sensor is fixedly arranged on the underwater glider wing. The flow control targets of different parts on the underwater glider under different flow control strategies can be realized.

title: Underwater glider closed-loop active flow control device based on steady blowing and sucking flow
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater glider closed-loop active flow control device based on steady blowing and sucking flow and relates to the field of active flow control. The device comprises a diffused silicon pressure sensor arranged at the front end of the bottom of an underwater glider wing, wherein the diffusion silicon pressure sensor is connected with a control unit, the control unit isconnected with a micro water suction pump set located at the front end of the bottom of an underwater glider wing and a micro water spraying pump set located at the rear end of the bottom of the underwater glider wing, and the micro water suction pump set and the micro water spraying pump set are connected with a water storage bin through pipelines. The front end and the rear end of the upper surface of the underwater glider wing are each provided with a plurality of mechanical nozzles, the micro water suction pump set is connected with the mechanical nozzles located at the front end of the upper surface of the underwater glider wing, and the micro water spray pump set is connected with the mechanical nozzles located at the rear end of the upper surface of the underwater glider wing. Localor global effective flow change is obtained through local disturbance, and then the purposes of increasing lift, reducing resistance, improving a flow field, restraining noise and the like are achieved.

title: Offshore wind turbine jacket underwater grouting monitoring device
abstract: The invention discloses an offshore wind turbine jacket underwater grouting monitoring device in the technical field of grouting. The offshore wind turbine jacket underwater grouting monitoring devicecomprises a submarine main machine, a controller and a display, the controller is used for sending a control signal to control the submarine main machine to operate, and the submarine main machine and the controller are electrically connected through a signal cable; the submarine main machine comprises a waterproof shell, a camera, an illuminating lamp, a power system and a main control system, atelescopic frame driven by a telescopic device to stretch out and draw back is installed at the bottom of the submarine main machine, symmetrical clamping plates are hinged to an installation box atone end of the telescopic frame, and an electric magnet controlled by the controller is arranged on the outer side wall of each set of clamping plate. A grouting process can be monitored at any time,and the grouting quality is ensured; the grouting quality can be obtained through video recording or photographing and the like; the camera can be mounted and recycled without going into water, and convenience and quickness are achieved; and the orientation of the camera can be quickly adjusted for multi-directional monitoring.
note: borderline: controlled submarine unit for grouting monitoring

title: Remotely operated vehicles, systems, and methods for inspecting core shrouds
abstract: A remotely operated vehicle (ROV) for inspecting a core shroud having an outer surface may include: a body configured to be operatively connected to a tether; and/or a sensor, configured to be operatively connected to the body, and configured to provide inspection information of the shroud. The tether may be configured to provide vertical position information for the ROV relative to the outer surface. A system for inspecting a core shroud may include: a trolley; an arm; the tether; and/or the ROV. The arm may be configured to be operatively connected to the trolley. The ROV may be configured to be operatively connected to the arm via the tether. A method for inspecting a core shroud may include: installing a system for inspecting the shroud on the shroud; driving the system horizontally around the shroud; and/or using a sensor of the system to inspect the shroud.
note: borderline: ROV inside a nuclear reactor, not marine

title: Integrative propulsion and power generation device driven by axis-free contra rotating wheel flanges
abstract: The invention discloses an integrative propulsion and power generation device driven by axis-free contra rotating wheel flanges. The device comprises a guide pipe, and the guide pipe is internally provided with two rotating wheel assemblies which are axially and sequentially arranged along the guide pipe; each rotating wheel assembly comprises a stator, a rotor and a propeller which are sequentially arranged in the guide pipe in a sleeved mode, the stators are fixedly connected with the guide pipe, the two ends of each rotor are arranged on the guide pipe through bearings, the propellers rotate along with the rotors, and the rotating directions of the propellers in the two rotating wheel assemblies are opposite to each other. The integrative device is compact in structure, high in formed power density and thrust-weight ratio, long in service life, low in vibration noise and especially suitable for application to unmanned underwater vehicles, propulsion and power generation are conducted synchronously, the energy utilization rate is increased, and the stability is improved.
note: borderline: generic rim-driven propulsor

title: OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION FARM MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING UNMANNED AUTONOMOUS NAVIGATION VEHICLE
abstract: The present invention relates to an offshore wind power generation farm management system using an unmanned autonomous navigation vehicle, the system including: a drone configured to fly along a set route through autonomous navigation to inspect a blade and a tower of a wind power generator, which are exposed on the sea; a submersible configured to submerge into and move in the sea through autonomous navigation and inspect a structure of the wind power generator, which is positioned on the seabed; and a ship configured to house each of the drone and the submersible and carry the drone and the submersible to a position at which the wind power generator is formed, through autonomous navigation along the sea surface.
note: aerial + underwater drones

title: Memory association reinforcement learning-based embedded real-time underwater robot intelligent decision-making method
abstract: The invention provides a memory association reinforcement learning-based embedded real-time underwater robot intelligent decision-making method, in particular to an RBF neural network and Q-learning-combined underwater robot path planning intelligent decision-making method and belongs to the algorithm technical field. The step-by-step learning function of an underwater robot during a path exploration process can be realized through the autonomous learning capacity of Q learning and the function approximation capacity of an RBF (radial basis function) neural network. According to the method, the quaternion of the Q-learning for path planning is defined as an environmental state, a behavioral action, a timely score and state transition; a state-action value function Q(s, a) is gradually updated during exploration, so that learning can be performed; the RBF neural network is adopted to fit the result of the Q learning, namely, the state action value function; and an updated neural networkweight is the result of the learning, the neural network provides an environment state-to-behavior mapping relationship which can be used for intelligent decision making in unknown environments.

title: PLATED POLYMERIC WIND TURBINE COMPONENTS
abstract: A wind turbine component is disclosed. The wind turbine component may comprise a polymer substrate and a metal plating layer plated on a surface of the polymer substrate. The wind turbine component may be a nacelle or a wind turbine blade.
note: wind turbine component

title: Homing system and method for an autonomous underwater vehicle
abstract: A submarine homing system includes an acoustic emitter configured to emit an acoustic signal comprising at least two narrow-band tones, each narrow-band tone having a respective predetermined center frequency. An acoustic receiver is configured to receive the acoustic signal from the acoustic emitter, and produce one or more receiver signals. A processor is operatively connected to the acoustic receiver. The processor is configured to process the receiver signals to calculate a direction between the acoustic receiver and the acoustic emitter.

title: Underwater vehicle capable of supporting sail propulsion
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater vehicle capable of supporting sail propulsion. The underwater vehicle capable of supporting the sail propulsion comprises a main hull, a battery, a cross-shapedrudder, a propeller, a wing sail board, a solar cell panel, an aerovane, a sinking keel and alarming equipment. According to the underwater vehicle capable of supporting the sail propulsion, the design of the underwater vehicle can sail by means of wind power; and moreover, power can be effectively stored by using solar energy, and problems of fast electric energy consumption, insufficient batterypower storage and the like can be effectively solved, and therefore, the automation degree and cruising ability can be improved to a certain extent. As the rigid wing sail board is adopted, the operation is simple, the efficiency is high, the sailing performance can be improved, a sailboat can also be prevented from losing power when the sail is broken so that the underwater vehicle capable of supporting the sail propulsion is more beneficial for long-time working of an unmanned sailboat.
note: borderline: sail-assisted underwater vehicle, crew not stated

title: AUTONOMOUS UNDERWATER VEHICLES
abstract: Underwater vehicles capable of self-propulsion are described. An underwater vehicle includes a cross-flow turbine including two or more foils spaced apart from a main shaft. The foils have a pitch that is adjustable under control of a pitch control mechanism. The underwater vehicle also includes a frame supporting the main shaft. The frame enables rotation of the cross- flow turbine. The underwater vehicle additionally includes a generator-motor set including rotor and stator elements. The rotor element is in rotary communication with the main shaft.

title: Transmission of power underwater
abstract: A method provides power to a subsea equipment electrical system underwater, without a wet-mated electrical connection. The method includes temporarily coupling a rotary coupling element of a power source to the subsea equipment and turning that element to generate electric power on board the equipment. Subsea equipment that implements the method comprises: an on-board electric power generator connected to an electrical load such as a rechargeable battery to charge the battery when the generator is driven; and a rotary coupling element that is turned by an external drive to drive the generator. Alternative subsea equipment to implement the method comprises: a stator, but not a rotor, of an on-board electric power generator, which supplies current to the load when an externally-driven rotor is positioned adjacent to the stator and turned relative to the stator. A power source having a generator rotor is docked with the equipment for this purpose.
note: borderline: power transfer to subsea equipment

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SURVEYING OR MONITORING UNDERWATER FEATURES
abstract: A method and system of surveying or monitoring an underwater feature (32), such as a reef, coral colonies (32a,b,c)..or other benthic habitat, includes using a remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) (12) tethered to a surface vessel (14) by a tether (16) incorporating discrete positional coordinate determination and/or relay means (40). The ROV (12) is able to be controlled by a controller (28) to revisit the same positional coordinates of one or more parts of the underwater feature because the tether device provides to the surface vessel to record the unique positional coordinates of the part(s) and the ROV is thereafter able to be accurately repositioned at the part(s) at a later time or date. This aids accurate ongoing surveying or monitoring of a feature for changes.

title: PIPELINE MAINTENANCE AND INSPECTION VEHICLE
abstract: A vehicle (10) for performing operations on a subsea pipeline, such as a riser (2), carries one or more interchangeable modules (18) and is configured to translate along the riser (2). The vehicle (10) comprises an elongate support structure (12) for carrying the modules (18). Gripper arms (14, 16) hold the support structure (12) a predetermined distance away from the elongate body and cause translation of the vehicle (10) along the riser (2) using a hand-over-hand action, so as to allow the vehicle (10) to pass protuberances or obstacles, such as a clamp (8), on the riser (2).
note: subsea pipeline crawler

title: Multifunctional suspension type underwater robot and base station system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional suspension type underwater robot and a base station system thereof. The system comprises a base station connected to a seabed observation network and a suspension type underwater robot. The multifunctional suspension type underwater robot not only can automatically cruise in a cable-free state, but also can be connected to a base station system in a butt joint mode, and remote control is achieved. A base station system is generally connected to the submarine observation network, so that after the underwater robot is butted to a base station, an operator can remotely control the underwater robot to work near a junction box of the submarine observation network ashore. According to the multifunctional suspension type underwater robot and the base station system thereof, the advantages of large activity range and autonomous navigation of the AUV and the characteristics of flexible manual operation and high working capacity of the ROV are integrated, and the application range is wider than that of a pure ROV or AUV; and in addition, the power supply mode is flexible, power can be supplied by a battery capable of being wirelessly charged like an AUV, and wired power supply can also be directly realized by a cable.
