When an air vehicle or an underwater vehicle is in a voyage mode, electric energy of batteries is utilized, and the motor drives the large arms to swing around the main shaft so as to drive the wing to flap up and down and control the small arm to rotate, so that the wing rotates.
note: flapping wing for a self-charging bionic vehicle

title: Pressure type wave tide instrument observation system
abstract: The invention discloses a pressure type wave tide instrument observation system. The pressure type wave tide instrument observation system comprises a pile column and a pressure type wave tide instrument, a control box is mounted at the top of the pile; a maintenance platform is mounted at the pile exposed out of the water surface; a stabilizing disc is arranged on the pile close to the seabed; asludge pile is installed at the bottom of the pile column, a central control module and a storage battery are arranged in the control box, a solar panel is arranged outside the control box, the pressure type wave tide instrument is installed on the pile column in an up-down sliding mode, the pressure type wave tide instrument is electrically connected with the central control module, and the storage battery is electrically connected with the solar panel and the central control module. According to the pressure type wave tide instrument observation system, the building cost is low, the maintenance cost is low, the structure is firm and reliable, and typhoon and man-made damage is reduced to the minimum.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Three-anchor-system float type acoustic tomography measuring station
abstract: The invention discloses a three-anchor buoy type acoustic tomography measuring station, which relates to the technical field of ocean monitoring, comprises a base station base body and a measuring assembly, and is characterized in that the base station base body comprises an equipment cabin, an energy supply assembly is arranged at the top of the equipment cabin, a plurality of floating bodies are arranged around the equipment cabin, and a measuring assembly is arranged at the bottom of the equipment cabin; the measuring assembly comprises a hydrophone and an emitter; three anchor systems are evenly arranged around the base station base body in a surrounding mode and comprise anchors, the anchors are connected with the base station base body through anchor chains, and floaters are arranged at the positions, close to the base station base body, of the anchor chains. And a positioning and timing device is arranged at the top of the base station base body. The invention provides the three-anchor buoy type acoustic tomography measuring station which is stable in position, accurate in measurement and convenient to set.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Ocean maritime affair monitoring communication aerostat system
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean maritime affair monitoring communication aerostat system. The system comprises an aerostat body device and a ground guarantee box device; the aerostat body device comprises an aerostat flight structure, a first power supply system, a communication system, a multispectral photoelectric monitoring system and a wide-narrow band communication load; the ground guarantee box device comprises a frequency conversion mooring rope playback system, an industrial control system, a second power supply system, an aerostat communication system and an external communication system. The multispectral photoelectric monitoring system judges the change of seawater components by detecting a seawater reflection spectrum, so that waste oil discharge is found and red tide occurrence is predicted; illegal ships are directly monitored through visible light and thermal imaging. The wide-narrow band communication load provides communication backhaul data for the monitoring buoys which are arranged at a long distance, provides long-distance broadband communication for patrol ships, improves the real-time performance of ocean and maritime affair monitoring, and expands the monitoring range.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Sea observation platform for unmanned and automatic navigation
abstract: The invention discloses a sea observation platform for unmanned and automatic navigation. According to upward and downward movement of a water turbine which is arranged under sea and is pulled by a sea floating platform driven by wave, water flow entering into a water turbine casing is enabled to be guided by upper part guide blades and lower part guide blades to act on a one-way rotating rotor, the up and down movement is converted into one-way rotation of the rotor, by the adoption of the rotor, according to a transmission mechanism, and kinetic energy of rotation is transmitted into the rotor of a generation set which is accelerated by a speed shifting mechanism, so that sea wave energy is enabled to be converted into electrical energy; and a power supply system further comprises a solar photovoltaic system, the electrical energy generated by the solar photovoltaic system is taken as an auxiliary power supply for an observation platform, the electric energy converted from the sea wave energy is used as a main power supply for various systems, and a complemented method of the main power supply and the auxiliary power supply is used for providing power source for a propelling system and an intelligent control system. By providing adequate electric energy, the sea observation platform becomes the observation platform with functions of remote control, multi-method communication, visualized remote online monitoring and observing and the like, and the possibility of transparently supervising all sea observation stations in the country is realized.
note: unmanned surface observation platform

title: External pressure resistant cabin structure
abstract: The utility model discloses an external pressure resistant cabin body structure in the marine technical field, which comprises a shell, an outer side joint and an inner side joint are fixedly connected to the circumferential surfaces of the two sides of the shell through joint fasteners, a blanking cap and the outer side joint are fixedly connected to one end of the outer side joint through a blanking cap fastener, and two sealing rings are mounted at one end of the inner side joint. According to the pressure-resistant cabin, the safety performance and the pressure-resistant capacity of a traditional pressure-resistant cabin are effectively improved, and the installation efficiency of the pressure-resistant cabin body is further improved.
note: pressure-resistant cabin for marine submersible equipment

title: Doppler measuring instrument and assembling method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a Doppler measuring instrument and an assembling method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of underwater detection.The Doppler measuring instrument comprises a control unit, an energy converter, an electronic cabin, an energy converter base and a hoop unit, the hoop unit holds the energy converter base and the electronic cabin on the peripheral side of the energy converter base and the peripheral side of the electronic cabin, and the energy converter base and the electronic cabin are arranged on the control unit. The electronic cabin is provided with an accommodating space, the transducer base is arranged in the accommodating space of the electronic cabin, so that a screw groove is prevented from being formed in the detection surface of the transducer base, the control unit is accommodated in the accommodating space of the electronic cabin, and the transducer is arranged on the transducer base and is connected to the control unit. As the detection surface of the transducer base does not need to be provided with a screw groove, when the Doppler measuring instrument is used and moves in water, water flow does not generate eddy current on the detection surface of the transducer base to cause bubbles, and the detection precision of the Doppler measuring instrument is improved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: MARINE CREATURE OBSERVATION DEVICES AND THE FIXED WAY THAT USED A BUOYANCY SIEVE AND PULLEY
abstract: PURPOSE: A marine life observation device using a buoy body and a pulley and a fixing method thereof are provided to effectively and stably maintain the position of buoys in flexible response to changeable conditions of the sea or the seabed. CONSTITUTION: A marine life observation device using a buoy body and a pulley comprises an upper buoy(10), a machine part, a information collecting device, and a cable. The upper buoy floats on the sea and the machine part is arranged in the buoy. The information collecting device collects information of the sea or the seabed. The cable delivers the information of the information collecting device to the machine part. The upper buoy is connected to a buoy body(50) through a connector(30) moving on a pulley(70). The pulley is fixed on the seabed.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Controlled lifeboat deployer
abstract: A control system to control the descent of a seafaring vessel, such as a lifeboat, into water is disclosed herein. The control system, and an accompanying method, control the descent speed of the seafaring vessel to minimise the possibility of setback after splashdown, and thus increase the probability of a safe and orderly launch.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Lifting type ocean current monitoring buoy capable of automatically adjusting floating height
abstract: The invention provides a lifting type ocean current monitoring buoy capable of automatically adjusting the floating height, and relates to the technical field of ocean current monitoring buoys. The lifting type ocean current monitoring buoy with the floating height self-adjusting function comprises a platform, the bottom of the platform is fixedly connected with a balancing weight, the top of the platform is fixedly connected with a box body, the top of the platform is fixedly connected with a plurality of fixing frames, the fixing frames are fixedly connected to the outer side of the box body, and the box body is fixedly connected with the lifting type ocean current monitoring buoy. Solar cell panels are arranged in the multiple fixing frames, a threaded sleeve is arranged in the platform, the threaded sleeve penetrates through the platform and the box body and is rotationally connected with the platform and the box body, a movable sleeve is in threaded connection with the outer side of the threaded sleeve, and a positioning plate is fixedly connected with the outer side of the movable sleeve; and a cleaning assembly is arranged on the outer side of the positioning plate. According to the lifting type ocean current monitoring buoy with the floating height self-adjusting function, repelling of sea birds and cleaning of the solar cell panel are facilitated, a platform can be protected conveniently, and crashing is prevented.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Reinforcement learning-based AUV behavior planning and motion control method
abstract: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning-based AUV behavior planning and motion control method, which belongs to the technical field of underwater robots and aims at solving the problems of limited training experience and difficult application in a real environment as complex task planning by the AUV depends much on manual experience and a control method designed based on an intelligent algorithm needs an accurate environment mode. AUV tunnel detection is defined as a general task; behaviors corresponding to task completion comprise target trending, wall tracking and obstacle avoidance; a control instruction generated by the robot under water to complete the planned behavior is defined as an action; and when the AUV executes a tunnel detection task, a deep reinforcement learning DQN algorithm is used for real-time behavior planning, a corresponding deep learning behavior network is constructed, and planning of the tunnel detection task is completed. The AUV action network is trained by the DDPG method, the AUV is regarded as an environment model, and force-to-state mapping is obtained, thereby realizing the action control of the AUV.

title: Portable hydrology and water resource survey device
abstract: The utility model discloses a portable hydrology and water resource surveying device. The device structurally comprises a fixed plate group, an anemograph, a sleeve and a clamping mechanism, accordingto the utility model, the clamping mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the shell; inward thrust is applied to the bracket; the bracket drives the connecting plate to rotate inwards to enter the inner side of the mounting shell; then the sleeve is rotated to drive the rotating plate to rotate; the rotating plate drives the convex block to rotate to push the transmission plate outwards; therefore, the transmission plate drives the pull plate and the bottom of the elastic clamping plate to rotate outwards; and the top of the elastic clamping plate rotates inwards to enter the inner side of the clamping groove to be fixed, and meanwhile, the push rod is pushed to drive the limiting plate to enter the inner side of the limiting groove formed in the side surface of the inserting ring, so that the position of the bracket is fixed, and the beneficial effects of fixing the bracket, preventing the bracket from rotating randomly and being more convenient to store and carry are achieved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Disc rotors with permanent magnets for brushless DC motor
abstract: A brushless dc permanent magnet motor drives an autonomous underwater vehicle. In one embodiment, the motor comprises four substantially flat stators in stacked relationship, with pairs of the stators axially spaced, each of the stators comprising a tape-wound stator coil, and first and second substantially flat rotors disposed between the spaced pairs of stators. Each of the rotors includes an annular array of permanent magnets embedded therein. A first shaft is connected to the first rotor and a second, concentric shaft is connected to the second rotor, and a drive unit causes rotation of the two shafts in opposite directions. The second shaft comprises a hollow tube having a central bore in which the first shaft is disposed. Two different sets of bearings support the first and second shafts. In another embodiment, the motor comprises two ironless stators and pairs of rotors mounted on opposite sides of the stators and driven by counterrotating shafts.
note: motor of an AUV

title: Remotely operated vehicle
abstract: A remotely operated vehicle (ROV) provided with not less than three thrusters arranged in the longitudinal direction of a vehicle body. The center of gravity G of the vehicle body excluding a pendulum and the center of buoyancy B of the vehicle body including the pendulum are set in agreement with each other, and the pendulum is provided so that it can be turned around a Y-axis extending in the lateral direction of the vehicle body and passing the center of gravity G thereof.

title: Deepwater floating type information monitoring platform adopting composite anchoring equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a deepwater floating information monitoring platform adopting composite anchoring equipment, and the platform comprises a floating platform and the composite anchoring equipment, the floating platform comprises an upper deck, a vertical column, an equipment cabin and a ballast tank, the equipment cabin is connected with the upper deck through the vertical column, and the ballast tank is connected to the lower part of the equipment cabin; the composite anchoring equipment comprises an anchoring chain and a multi-anchor structure connected with the anchoring chain, the anchoring chain is provided with multiple sections, at least one of the two sections is a mooring cable, and the other section is an anchor chain; wherein the mooring chain is connected with the equipment compartment and/or the ballast compartment, and the mooring chain is flexibly connected with the seabed through a multi-anchor structure. According to the application, the composite anchoring equipment is used as a mooring structure, so that the monitoring platform can be applied to the water depth of 3000m; the double-anchor design is adopted, the mechanical property is excellent, and rapid laying in deep sea areas can be achieved; the floating platform is simple in structure and convenient to construct in quantity and arrange in the whole sea area; the whole device has excellent hydrodynamic performance, self-guarantee capability, carrying capability and communication capability.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Submerged datacenter
abstract: The subject disclosure is directed towards a submerged datacenter, which may be made up of modules, into a body of water such as the ocean. The submersion facilitates cooling of the datacenter as well as providing protection of the datacenter from environmental conditions that exist at or near the surface. Power may be generated from the datacenter heat, and power generated by or near the body of water (e.g., via waves, tides, wind, currents, temperature differences) may be used to help power the datacenter.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Method and apparatus for cleaning, viewing and documenting the condition of weldments on offshore platforms
abstract: A subsea platform inspection vehicle on a power tether cable adapted to be propelled through the water and lock onto an underwater member of a platform adjacent a welded joint and provided with a jet to clean a weld and a television camera to observe the condition of the weld.
note: tethered inspection vehicle

title: Method for measuring velocity and direction of currents in a body of water
abstract: A method for measuring the velocity and direction of currents in the ocean and other bodies of water. A first vehicle travels through water and leaves behind a trail of dye. A second vehicle travels, at a later time, the same path as that traveled by the first vehicle, and measures the distance and direction to the trail of dye. The vehicles may travel either from the surfaces downwardly or from the bottom upwardly.
note: vehicles travelling under water to measure currents

title: OFFSHORE ACOUSTIC RANCH FARMING PLATFORM
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of marine ranches, and particularly relates to an offshore acoustic ranch farming platform. The platform comprises an offshore working platform, an energy supply device is provided on the offshore working platform, and an underwater acoustic system is provided under the offshore working platform; the underwater acoustic system is located in sea water; pile foundations are excited by excitation devices to generate acoustic waves having different frequency characteristics, and using fish-school-sensitive acoustic waves, fish schools are attracted, driven, and fed. The purposes are to use an acoustic adjustment and control technology for reducing the requirements of a marine ranch on conventional marine mechanical equipment, for greatly reducing dependency on existing marine equipment and cost input, for reducing pollution to a marine ecological environment, and for promoting building of marine ranches.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Offshore all-dimensional three-dimensional wave observation system and installation and use method
abstract: The invention relates to a maritime all-dimensional three-dimensional wave observation system and an installation and use method, the maritime all-dimensional three-dimensional wave observation system comprises a shooting end used for shooting, and the shooting end is fixedly installed on the edge of a maritime structure through a fixing base; the shooting end is connected with a control end used for controlling the shooting process of the shooting end; the control end is in communication connection with the buoy end through wireless communication, and the buoy end floats on the sea surface. The system is composed of a shooting end, a control end and a buoy end, water surface and water multi-dimensional and all-directional measurement is achieved, data are integrated and analyzed through the control end, and the measurement precision is improved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Power unit of underwater vehicle
abstract: The present invention provides a power unit of an underwater vehicle, which allows reduction in size and weight of a transformer for stepping down a power voltage of a power supply to increase a loading amount of a variety of devices with respect to the underwater vehicle, so as to obtain a favorable operating environment. The power unit is connected to the power supply through a cable and receives power through the cable. Further, the power unit comprises an electronic transformer having: a rectifier for rectifying a high-voltage alternate current power of the power supply into a direct current; a high-frequency converter for converting an output of the rectifier into a high-frequency alternate current; a transformer for stepping down an output voltage of the high-frequency converter; a rectifier for rectifying an output of the transformer into a direct current; and a control circuit for controlling the high-frequency converter.
note: power unit of a cable-powered underwater vehicle

title: Marked measuring point measuring device for ocean engineering
abstract: The invention provides a marking measuring point measuring device for ocean engineering, and relates to the field of marking measuring points, the marking measuring point measuring device comprises a fixing shell, the fixing shell is of a rectangular shell structure, and a mounting space is formed in the fixing shell; a supporting seat is slidably arranged in the mounting space of the fixed shell; a collecting shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting seat; under the cooperation of a collecting shell and a supporting seat, when the device encounters heavy rain and other weather, the supporting seat is retracted into the fixing shell to sequentially protect other parts of the device, so that the service life of the device is prolonged, and the device can be automatically protected in strong wind and heavy rain weather; the problem that due to the fact that the weather environment on the sea surface is relatively bad, a measuring point marking device needs to face heavy rain and the like, and if the measuring point marking device does not have a good protection mechanism for protecting components of the measuring point marking device, the components of the device may be damaged by the heavy rain and the like is solved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Wave-proof device for ocean monitoring
abstract: The utility model discloses a wave-proof device for ocean monitoring, which relates to the technical field of ocean monitoring and comprises a base, and a support column is fixedly mounted in the middle of the upper surface of the base. The utility model discloses a wave-proof device for ocean monitoring. The arc surface of the buffer groove is in contact with sea waves; slow flow is guided to theleft lower side; guided sea waves are conducted into the flow guide groove through the flow slowing groove; guiding the mixture into a horizontal flow cavity; cavity enlargement, the flow slowing effect is achieved; therefore, the sea waves subjected to pressure relief flow out gently; avoiding in use, impact of sea waves directly acts on the device, so that the device is damaged. In the processthat the buffer groove is impacted, the impact force drives the flow guide plate to rotate with the cylinder as the circle center, the connecting rod pushes the jacking column to be pushed upwards inthe sliding hole, the height of the monitoring equipment installed on the jacking column is increased, the monitoring equipment is better driven to conduct self-adaptive height adjustment during sea wave impact, and the self-adjusting effect of the device is improved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: A MOBILE OFFSHORE DRILLING UNIT AND METHOD OF CONTROLLING A PROCESS AUTOMATION SYSTEM
abstract: The invention is related a floating mobile offshore drilling and a method of controlling a process automation system thereon. The floating mobile offshore drilling rig comprising a wave prediction system, a movement predictor unit, a process automation system configured to perform at least one operational sequence on board the mobile offshore drilling unit within a predetermined safe operating envelope. The process automation system is configured to enable at least one operational sequence when predicted movement of the mobile offshore drilling unit is within a predetermined safe operating envelope for the at least one operational sequence.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Sea-air-underwater integrated self-supply detection device and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a sea-air-underwater integrated self-supply detection device and a detection method thereof in the technical field of offshore unmanned systems.The sea-air-underwater integrated self-supply detection device comprises an underwater robot main body, an unmanned ship main body and an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and the unmanned ship main body comprises a lead screw guide rail mechanism, a second transponder and an optical guide array; the unmanned aerial vehicle main body comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle receiving end coil and a navigation positioning system, the unmanned aerial vehicle receiving end coil induces the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging output end coil, and the navigation positioning system provides route guidance and positioning setting; the underwater robot main body is positioned to the docking protection bin through communication between the first transponder and the second transponder, and then is positioned to the docking protection bin through recognition of the optical guide array by the machine vision recognition camera, and the underwater robot main body is charged through the robot output end coil and the underwater robot receiving end coil. According to the invention, the problems of short endurance and difficult communication of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the underwater robot during ocean operation are solved, and the detection range and the working efficiency can be effectively improved.
note: system with an underwater robot

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR THE MOUNTING, DEPLOYMENT AND USE OF HYDROGRAPHIC SURVEYING DEVICES
abstract: A vessel of generally conventional design is provided with a hydrographic survey apparatus in which the transducer of the survey apparatus is mounted on a boom swingable about a substantially horizontal axis between a deployed and stowed position. The boom is located in a slot aligned in a vertical plane along the boat's centerline and extends downward from the boat's top deck. The boom is mounted at one end near the bow of the boat by attachment to a drive shaft extending beam-wise or transversely across the slot. The drive shaft is operated by a hydraulic rotary actuator. The transducer is mounted on the free end of the boom and is swingable about the drive shaft into and out of the water. The transducer is thus selectively movable from a stowed position to a deployed position in front of the vessel where it is placed in still non-turbulent water, i.e.; water that is free from mechanical vibration and noise of the survey boat and aquatic turbulence from the hull.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Satellite navigation and positioning unmanned aerial vehicle loaded micro monitoring equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of river channel monitoring, in particular to satellite navigation and positioning unmanned aerial vehicle loaded micro monitoring equipment, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a monitor, a connecting line, a lifting device and a controller. The monitor comprises a monitoring rod and a floating plate; a detector is arranged in the monitoring rod; a cavity is formed in the monitoring rod; and a first magnet ring and an electric push rod are arranged in the cavity. The electric push rod pushes the first magnet ring to move, the first magnet ring enables the second magnet ring to move together under the action of common magnetic force of the first magnet ring and the second magnet ring, and then the second magnet ring is matched with the thrust of suspended garbage wound on the monitoring rod when the second magnet ring moves, so that the purpose that the suspended garbage in the water flow cannot make contact with the monitor during monitoring of the monitor is achieved, the risk that the unmanned aerial vehicle flies unstably for a long time and falls off due to the fact that the acting force of the water flow on the monitor is increased by the suspended garbage is prevented, and the using effect of the equipment is improved.
note: aerial drone with water monitor

title: Method for planning the journey of a submarine
abstract: A method and system for planning the journey of a submarine are provided using at least one electrical drive with a battery for energy supply and a charging device for the battery. For a selected future point in time, the remaining available energy reserve of the battery is predicted on the basis of the travel duration up to this point in time, of at least of one consumption profile selected for the travel duration, and of the type and duration of the charging cycles of the battery being effected up to this point in time.
note: submarine journey planning (battery submarine)

title: Marine ecology automatic monitoring buoy system
abstract: The utility model relates to a marine ecology automatic monitoring buoy system, including basic braced system, data collection and transmission system, positioning system, power supply system, instrument monitoring system, anchor system, safety assistant system. The utility model discloses an advantage embodies: in appearance, whole buoy system, it is simply generous, accord with very much modern's aesthetics, structural, the instrument is thrown in the groove and in succession mutually that to float be buoy body and turriform support on the surface of water, and whole the interlinkage is born fruit firmly, can adapt to exceedingly odious weather, in the material, adopt polyurea material and stainless steel material, have high corrosion resisting property concurrently, guarantee the life of system.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Early warning buoy for seawater detection
abstract: The early warning buoy comprises a main body, a stand column is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the main body, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the stand column, and a solar mounting base is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the mounting plate; when the buoy shakes, the closed center-of-gravity position is adjusted, so that the buoy can quickly recover to a balanced state, the stability of the buoy is improved, a detection result is prevented from being influenced, the possibility of overturning of the buoy is reduced, fresh water is obtained by distilling seawater, the survival time of survivors is prolonged, and the survival rate of the survivors is increased. In addition, when the seawater is distilled, distress signals can be generated through the antenna, so that the searching time of rescuers for survivors is shortened, and moreover, the probe is regularly cleaned through the brush bristles, and the situation that the detection precision is affected due to the fact that attachments exist on the surface of the probe is prevented.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Novel multi -functional environmental protection navigation mark lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel multi -functional environmental protection navigation mark lamp, include: the navigation mark lamp main part is with the complementary power generation system of navigation mark lamp main part fixed connection's clean energy, many information collection system and location and communication system, wherein: the complementary power generation system of clean energy includes solar power system, wind power generation device and wave energy power generation facility, the navigation mark lamp main part is including setting up the body in the bottom, and wave energy power generation facility sets up in body centre of gravity place's below, and solar energy power generation facility and wind energy power generation facility set up the upper surface at the body,still set up organic box and battery pack module on the centre of gravity place of body, machine box top is provided with the fairway buoy lighting fixture, and the top of fairway buoy lighting fixture is provided with the navigation mark lamp, the navigation mark lamp links to each other with battery pack module through the machine box, many information collection system and location and communication system all set up at the machine box insidely. The utility model discloses utilize solar energy, wind energy, wave energy power supply, can be automatically to sea wave, temperature and atmospheric pressure etc. The hydrometeorology key element carry out the telemetering measurement.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: On-site monitoring system for performance of elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for deep-sea buoys
abstract: The invention discloses an on-site monitoring system for the performance of an elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for deep-sea buoys, and particularly relates to the field of deep-sea monitoring. The on-site monitoring system auxiliary comprises a central processing module, wherein the output end of the central processing module is separately connected with an information display module,an information storage module, an auxiliary recovery module and a driving module, and the input end of the central processing module is separately connected with a power supply module, a monitoring module, a correction module and a positioning module. According to the on-site monitoring system for the performance of the elastic loose type anchorage system suitable for the deep-sea buoys, the auxiliary recovery module is arranged, air bags are installed at a plurality of node positions on the anchorage system, a booster pump in a pressurization unit is used, outside air is conveyed into a floating ball unit through a pipeline unit, so that the retractable air bags are enabled to bulge upwards to float, the whole anchor system is directly floated in sections, people conveniently recycle theanchorage system greatly, the workload during the recycling process is reduced, and the practicability is high.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement
abstract: The invention discloses a shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement, and belongs to the field of overall design of ships. The method comprises the steps that wave height distribution in the ship advancing direction is determined based on a radar signal, in the ship advancing direction, measured by wave measuring radar; the wave height is measured through a target wave measurement buoy; the wave height measured by the target wave measurement buoy is adopted as the standard, the wave height distribution measured by the wave measuring radar is corrected, and the wave height distribution about to be encountered by the ships in next m minutes is obtained; and according to the wave height distribution about to be encountered by the ship in the next m minutes, a seakeeping quick forecasting technique is adopted for forecasting the motion of the ships in the next m minutes, a self-adaptation correction technique based on very short-range forecasting is adopted for carrying out self-adaption correction on the measured actual motion of the ships and the motion forecast theoretically, the corrected motion result of the ships in the next mminutes is obtained and compared with a shipboard aircraft landing criterion to complete auxiliary decision making. According to the shipboard aircraft landing auxiliary decision-making method and device based on wave measurement, a more precise forecasting result can be obtained.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Stable offshore floating observation device convenient to recycle
abstract: The invention discloses a stable offshore floating observation device convenient to recycle. The device comprises a device main body, a solar panel, a wind power generation main body, a warning lamp,an antenna, a comprehensive meteorological sensor, a wind speed and direction sensor, a propelling propeller, a hydrology and water quality sensor, a storage battery, a solar power generation controller, an inverter, a wind power generation controller, a remote control main body, a driving motor and a central processing unit; the solar panel, a supporting frame and the wind power generation body are installed in the upper side of the device body, and the wind power generation body is located in the inner side of the supporting frame. According to the stable offshore floating observation deviceconvenient to recycle, the position of the observation device on the offshore is ensured to be fixed, the driving motor, a transmission gear and a take-up roller are arranged in a mooring rope plummet body, a mooring rope can be directly taken up, and therefore an anchor body can be taken up, the observation device can be conveniently taken up and moved, and the use efficiency of the device is improved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: MAXIMUM WATER LEVEL DETECTING DEVICE FOR UNDERGROUND WATER
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a maximum underground water level detecting device to easily and cheaply detect a maximum ultimate water level for a limited period, smoothly remove gas generated from the bottom of a borehole in spite of small diameter of the borehole, thereby reduce errors, and perform sensitive measuring. SOLUTION: A maximum water level detecting device is made up of a stand pipe 18 which is inserted into a borehole 12 and in which the underground-water level is freely moved up and down, and a number of water vessels 30 which are connected at intervals in turn by a connecting material such as a rope 32 to be arranged in the stand pipe 18 so that they can freely be inserted into and pulled out of the stand pipe. Each water vessel 30 has a bottom-blind and lidded cylindrical part provided with a curved side face 30a conforming to the internal configuration of the stand pipe 18, a water introducing port 34 is opened to the upper position of the side face, and mounting parts for the connecting materials are provided on the upper end part and on the lower end part. Then, a maximum water lever is detected by the position of the uppermost water vessel 30 filled with underground-water during the period of measuring in the stand pipe 18.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Electromagnetic mechanical brake, method and application
abstract: The invention discloses an electromagnetic mechanical brake, a method and application, and belongs to the field of underwater vehicle brakes. Comprising a bevel gear pair, an electromagnet assembly and a track limiting assembly, meshing and disconnection of the gear pair are controlled through the electromagnet assembly, and the state of the brake is locked through the track limiting assembly; braking is generated through contact of the two gear pairs, contact of the two gear pairs is completed through the characteristics of zero control of the motor, cooperation with the bevel gear with spring pressure and self-alignment meshing, and therefore the limit of the friction coefficient on the braking torque is changed. A compression spring of the electromagnet assembly is combined with a special limiting groove type structure to achieve keeping or disconnection of the brake, and the braking process is stable and free of collision. The brake is in a complete structure contact mode, and the stable and reliable braking effect in the high-pressure and lubricating oil filling environment can be achieved. According to the invention, stable braking under the oil-filled environment of the underwater waterproof driving motor with the depth of more than 4000 m is realized.
note: brake for an underwater vehicle drive

title: Method to detect data transmitted from multiple antennas and system thereof
abstract: A method to detect data transmitted from multiple antennas, said method comprising steps of: selecting a starting data block and calling it as previous data block; defining a set of indices of bits to be checked for possible flip in the previous data block as a check candidate set; applying update rule to obtain updated data block using the previous data block and the check candidate set, wherein the update is made in such a manner that change in likelihood is positive; checking if the updated data block and several consecutive previous data blocks are the same; if yes, declare the updated data block as the detected data block; if no, make updated data block as previous data block and repeat updation of data block.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: All-weather hydrological monitoring system with water-light complementary energy
abstract: The invention discloses an all-weather hydrological monitoring system with water-light complementary energy, and the system comprises a floating unit which comprises a floating part and an electrical box; the hydrological monitoring unit is arranged in the electrical box and comprises a camera and a plurality of hydrological monitoring sensors, a lens of the camera is arranged downwards, and probes of the hydrological monitoring sensors penetrate through the bottom of the electrical box and then are located below the electrical box; the control unit is arranged in the electrical box and is electrically connected with the hydrological monitoring unit and the upper computer; the power storage unit is arranged in the electrical box, is electrically connected with the hydrological monitoring unit and the control unit and is used for supplying power to the hydrological monitoring unit; the hydroelectric generation unit is connected below the floating piece through a connecting rope and is electrically connected with the electric power storage unit; and the solar power generation unit is arranged at the top of the electrical box and is electrically connected with the power storage unit. The system is applied to the field of hydrological monitoring, power is supplied to the system through hydroelectric generation and solar power generation, water-light complementary green power generation is achieved, and 24-hour all-weather hydrological monitoring is achieved.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: BUOY FOR MEASURING TSUNAMI
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buoy for measuring tsunami which can be improved in tsunami detecting ability without receiving any influence from waves. SOLUTION: In a buoy for measuring tsunami, a horizontal fin 23 is attached to the upper surface of a balance weight 22 fixed to the lower end (underwater) of a bar-like buoy main body 21 having buoyancy. Since the horizontal fin 23 functions as a resistance plate that stabilizes the buoy main body 21 in the vertical direction against ordinary waves, the influence of the ordinary waves on the main body 21 can be minimized. Since the fin 23 also functions as a detecting plate for efficiently grasping the movement of a water mass at a deeper portion of the bottom face of the main body 21 while having a certain degree of cross-sectional area against tsunami, the buoy can more easily grasp the wave height of tsunami and wave height detecting ability of the buoy for tsunami can be improved.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

abstract: 1,179,904. Mooring systems GLOBAL MARINE Inc. 5 May, 1967 [9 May, 1966], No. 32278/69. Divided out of 1,179,903. Heading B7S. title: WAVE MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To efficiently monitor waves arriving from multi-directions, while suppressing cost involved.SOLUTION: A wave monitoring system 10 includes: a plurality of buoys 12 installed around a zone CA of a construction work on-water; imaging means 14 for imaging the images of the plurality of buoys 12; analysis means for analyzing the wave generated around the zone in real time based on the image of the buoy 12 imaged by the imaging means 14; and display means for displaying an analysis result of the analysis means. A commercial PC and the like are used as the analysis means and the display means, and consequently, can be structured extremely inexpensive as compared with the conventional device for observing and analyzing the waves. In addition, the installation thereof can be easily performed. Nevertheless, since the system is designed for the purpose of analyzing and displaying the waves from the images of the plurality of buoys 12 installed around the zone CA, the waves generated in the multi-directions can be efficiently monitored.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Multi-mode propulsion glide submarine
abstract: The invention provides a submarine, which has two functions of under water and on water surface, mainly by means of wind energy resource (rich and reusable) as power in the sea, using glide, sail, propeller three driving approaches to drive glide submarine. The submarine is comprised of vessel body, elevator, vertical tail plane, multi functions sail wing, wind power electrical generator, storage battery, electrical driving system, manpower driving system, diesel oil and electric integrative system, submarine elevating system, and live maintaining system, communications system and GPS, acoustic suscepance system (sonar system), and so on. The submarine adopts gliding wing or propeller drive under water, on water surface while with sail and propeller drive, wind power electrical generator may also be used for generating. During submarine is in underwater operation, submarine is buoyed and sunk through changing the specific gravity of submarine, such changing of gravity and buoyancy is become the power of submarine for advancing through multi functions sail wing.
note: glide submarine with life-support and manpower drive: crewed

title: Mooring system and method for power generation systems and other payloads in water flows
abstract: A mooring system for deploying flow kinetic power generation systems in a water flow and placing the power generation systems to a position across moving path of the water flow from an anchoring point, the mooring system comprises: a main tether; an anchor means attached to a first end of the main tether and fixed to the anchoring point; and a main sail means attached to a second end of the main tether and immersed in the water flow; wherein the power generation systems is attached to the second end of the main tether; and the relative to the main sail means creates a fluid dynamic lift force on the main sail means and pulls the power generation systems in a lateral direction with respect to the moving path of the water flow. The mooring system may also be applied to moor and deploy other payloads and devices transversely across a water flow.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

title: Deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of marine exploration equipment. The system comprises a buoyancy oil bag, an oil outlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve, an overflow valve, a hydraulic motor, a throttling valve, an oil outlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, an oilstorage oil bag, a controller, an oil inlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve, a hydraulic pump, a pressure reducing valve, an oil inlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, a one-way valve, a pressure transmitter and a flow meter, wherein the controller is connected with the flow meter, the pressure transmitter, the oil outlet normally open type electromagneticreversing valve, the overflow valve, the throttling valve, the oil outlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, the oil inlet normally closed type electromagnetic reversing valve, themotor and the oil inlet normally open type electromagnetic reversing valve through signal lines. According to the system, electric energy can be emitted by utilizing the pressure of seawater, the working state of a reversing valve of a hydraulic system is controlled, the energy consumption in the working process of the deep sea equipment buoyancy regulating system is reduced, and the working timeof deep sea equipment is prolonged.
note: buoyancy regulation for deep-sea exploration equipment

title: Assembly for connecting a jumper to a subsea structure
abstract: An assembly for connecting a jumper to a subsea structure. The assembly comprises a jumper connector attached to an end of the jumper that has a vertically disposed main body adapted for receiving a plurality of lines, which connect into a corresponding plurality of vertically oriented female couplers disposed within the main body. The connector assembly further comprises a mating socket attached to the subsea structure that has a substantially cylindrically shaped main housing formed with a longitudinal slot and a corresponding plurality of vertically oriented male couplers. A remotely operated vehicle (ROV) vertically aligns the jumper connector with the mating socket and connects the plurality of female couplers to the corresponding plurality of male couplers.
note: connector aligned and connected by an ROV

title: Automated positioning and submersible open ocean platform
abstract: An open-ocean fish-growing platform has a submersible cage structure for growing fish, an antenna for receiving positioning signals transmitted from an external source, a position-correction apparatus for calculating a position error signal from a target geostationary position, and an ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC) system for generating electric power for thruster units to maintain the cage structure in the target geostationary position. The OTEC system inducts colder ocean water from a deeper ocean depth for driving its heat exchange cycle, and is also of hybrid type using a fuel-fired unit as a heat source. The cold water effluent from the OTEC system is directed into the cage for flushing wastes generated by the growing fish. The self-positioning, self-powered open-ocean platform enables unmanned, extended marine deployment in deeper ocean waters without the need for tethering or anchoring to the ocean floor.
note: unmanned self-positioning submersible platform with thrusters

title: Method for salvaging sunken ship by adopting rubber air bag
abstract: The invention discloses a method for salvaging a sunken ship by adopting a rubber air bag. The method comprises the process steps that for the sunken ship, salvaging preparation is implemented, a construction site is arranged, barriers in the salvage procedure is cleared, then a jacking hole 3 is drilled in the bottom of the sunken ship, a jacking steel cable penetrates through the jacking hole 3, a rubber air bag 7 covered with a fixed net cover sinks to a mounting position in an air-free state, the fixed net cover, the jacking steel cable 11 and a movable chain ring 7 are connected and installed by a diver or an underwater robot, then an inflatable appliance on the water surface is used for inflating an air bag group, the volume of the air bag is increased so as to generate buoyancy, and the air bag pulls the steel cable 11 at the bottom of the sunken ship, so that the sunken ship 1 is lifted by buoyancy so as to be wholly risen or risen by sections.
note: ship salvage with air bags; diver or robot only mentioned

title: Underwater spring piston type buoyancy compensating device
abstract: The invention provides an underwater spring piston type buoyancy compensating device which comprises a pressure resistance shell and one or more sets of spring piston type motion mechanisms. The spring piston type motion mechanisms comprise piston rods, springs, universal pressing heads and limiting drawing pins. The pressure resistance shell is provided with piston holes matched with the piston rods. The piston rods are of a step shaft structure, and the matching positions of the piston rods and the pressure resistance shell play the function of sealing the shell through arranged sealing pieces. The lower portions of the piston rods are spherical and are matched with the universal pressing heads. The upper portions of the piston rods are provided with the limiting drawing pins and check screws. By means of the device, the number of the spring piston type motion mechanisms can be selected according to the requirement for the compensation speed. The universal pressing heads can rotate on the piston rods so as to adapt to different directions of the load. When the load is loaded, the universal pressing heads are abutted, at the moment, the springs are in the compression state, the limiting drawing pins are drawn, after the load is released, the piston rods are bounced off under the action of restoring force of the springs, sealing is invalid, water entering occurs, and the buoyancy change, caused by load releasing, of an underwater unmanned vehicle is compensated.
note: buoyancy compensator for an underwater unmanned vehicle

title: ATTITUDE CONTROL SYSTEM AND ATTITUDE CONTROL METHOD FOR UNDERWATER FLOATING TYPE POWER GENERATION DEVICE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an attitude control system and an attitude control method for an underwater floating type power generation device, which enable the attitude of the underwater floating type power generation device to be efficiently corrected when the device is tilted in the roll direction.SOLUTION: There is provided an attitude control system S for an underwater floating type power generation device 1 that comprises a plurality of pods 2A, 2B provided with power generation turbines 4A, 4B, respectively, and a cross beam 3 extending between the plurality of pods 2A, 2B and connecting the plurality of pods 2A, 2B together. The attitude control system S for the underwater floating type power generation device comprises a gyro sensor for detecting the inclination angle of the underwater floating type power generation device 1 at least in the roll direction, rotation speed regulating means provided in the respective power generation turbines 4A, 4B and capable of regulating rotation speeds of the power generation turbines 4A, 4B, and a control part for controlling the rotation speed regulating means according to the inclination angle detected by the gyro sensor to change the rotation speed of at least one of the power generation turbines 4A, 4B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
note: underwater power generation device

title: Extended duration autonomous craft
abstract: Autonomous craft capable of extended duration operations as lighter-than-air craft, having the ability to alight on the surface of a body of water and generate hydrogen gas for lift via electrolysis using power derived from a photovoltaic system, as well as methods of launching an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having a deployable envelope from a surface of a body of water.
note: lighter-than-air craft alighting on water

title: Sinking surrounding type cabin raft
abstract: The invention relates to a sinking surrounding type cabin raft which comprises a lower raft frame, a plurality of upper vibration isolators and a plurality of lower vibration isolators, wherein the lower raft frame includes an upper-layer frame and a lower-layer frame, the upper-layer frame is fixedly connected with the lower-layer frame, and the lower-layer frame is used for lowering a gravity center of the lower raft frame; the plurality of upper vibration isolators are arranged at upper parts of a first side frame and a second side frame of the upper-layer frame, and the first side frame and the second side frame are oppositely arranged; and the plurality of lower vibration isolators are arranged at lower parts of the first side frame and the second side frame. The gravity center of thesinking surrounding type cabin raft is lowered through the lower-layer frame arranged on the lower raft frame so that when the equipment is mounted on the sinking surrounding type cabin raft, the overall gravity center of the sinking surrounding type cabin raft and the equipment is lowered, a phenomenon that the equipment installed on the sinking surrounding type cabin raft shakes due to the toohigh gravity center is avoided, a noise generated by shaking is avoided, and then vibration isolation performance and stability performance of the sinking surrounding type cabin raft are improved.
note: vibration-isolation raft

title: Thrust vectoring control of a cyclorotor
abstract: A device for controlling thrust vectoring of a cyclorotor includes a control cam positionable relative to a drive shaft of a cyclorotor along each of a first axis and a second axis, where the drive shaft is rotatable about a third axis. The device may further include a frame having a plurality of sides, where the frame is disposed at least partly around the drive shaft of the cyclorotor, a first positioning assembly disposed on a first side of the frame, where the first positioning assembly is structurally configured to move the frame along the first axis, and a second positioning assembly disposed on a second side of the frame, where the second positioning assembly is engaged with the control cam and structurally configured to move the control cam relative to the frame along the second axis.
note: cyclorotor thrust vectoring, medium not stated

title: WTIV CLV Vessel integrating Wind Turbine Installation Function and Cable Laying Function
abstract: The present invention relates to a multifunctional vessel combining a wind turbine installation vessel (WTIV) and a cable laying vessel (CLV). The multifunctional vessel combining the WTIV and the CLV comprises: a hull (10) having a crane (15) to mount and install a wind power generator; a pulling unit (20) pulling a power line of the wind power generator on an ocean floor by using an inductor (23) and a winding drum (21) mounted on the hull (10); a berthing unit (30) having a berthing plate (33) on a transfer plate (31) to enable berthing when the wind power generator is installed; and a fueling unit (40) installed to exchange oil by a hose member (41) when the wind power generator is installed. Therefore, the multifunctional vessel combining the WTIV and the CLV has the wind power generator and has a power cable additionally installed from the wind power generator to the ground. Also, the multifunctional vessel combining the WTIV and the CLV can support work of maintenance and the like, thereby improving general efficiency and reducing costs.
note: wind-turbine installation vessel

title: WAVE HEIGHT MEASURING INSTRUMENT
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wave height measuring instrument capable of measuring accurately a wave height by compact and simple constitution.

SOLUTION: A vector composition circuit 31 calculates a vector indicated by expression (1):Zvec=v(x2+y2+z2)-g, based on outputs from an X-axis-Y-axis accelerometer 21 and a Z-axis accelerometer 23, where Zvec represents a vertical acceleration of the wave after vector composition, X represents an X-axial acceleration measured value, Y represents a Y-axial acceleration measured value, Z represents a Z-axial acceleration measured value, and g represents an earth gravitational acceleration. A band-pass filter 33 with a double integration function double-integrates the vertical acceleration Zvec of the wave to be converted into a displacement, and removes a natural period component and a drift component of a buoy floating body, by the band-pass filter.

title: MARINE OBSERVATION SYSTEM, SELF-FLOATING UP TYPE MARINE OBSERVATION DEVICE AND DISCHARGE DEVICE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a marine observation system which obtains a result obtained by observing a vertical structure of a marine phenomenon at a specified point for a long period of time at a real time by an inexpensive and simple method.

SOLUTION: One or a plurality of self-floating up type marine observation devices 2 provided with a self-floating up buoyancy part 4 and observing the marine phenomenon while floated up, are installed, and the respective self-floating up type marine observation devices 2 are separated off from the discharge device 1 landed on a sea bottom by own weight according to a predetermined schedule. Thereby, the marine phenomenon is observed by a sensor part 6 while self-floating up in the sea in a vertical direction respectively and is temporarily accumulated in a memory of an electronic circuit part 5. When they reach the sea surface, observation data accumulated in the memory are transmitted on radio by an aerial part 3. The observation data include at least one of depth, water temperature and salinity, or a plurality of them. When it is detected that an average value of the depth or the water temperature in every predetermined time is not varied during the predetermined number, it is determined that the self-floating up type marine observation devices 2 are floated up to the sea surface.

abstract: A communication system includes: a transmitter including a transmission circuit unit generating an RF signal for transmitting data and an electrical-field coupling antenna transmitting the RF signal as an electrostatic field or an induction field; a receiver including an electrical-field coupling antenna and a reception circuit unit subjecting an RF signal received by the electrical-field coupling antenna to reception processing; and a surface-wave propagation device including a plurality of linear surface-wave transmission lines for propagating a surface wave radiated from the electrical-field coupling antenna of the transmitter.

title: BUOY FOR OBSERVING TSUNAMI AND OCEAN WAVE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately measure the wave height of incident wave, within the limit of extension of a mooring cable.

SOLUTION: A floating buoy 21 is provided in a moored buoy 11 that is moored to an ocean bed through the mooring cable 4, and is held so as to rise flexibly, fall or be inclined. A rise/fall guide hole 18 is formed in a buoy body 12 of the moored buoy 11. The floating buoy 21 comprises a frame bar 23, fitted to the rise/fall guiding hole 18 so as to rise flexibly, fall and be inclined; a pair of measurement floats 22 attached to both ends of the frame bar 23, and floating on both sides of the buoy body; and a sea level displacement detecting section 24 for detecting the displacement of sea level by using the measurement floats 22.

title: Device for a vertical electromagnetic field component receiver
abstract: A device for disposing an antenna dipole arranged to be submerged in a water mass is described. A first electrode is placed, in an operative position, approximately vertically above and at a distance from a second electrode. A mast is pivotally secured, at a portion distant from, in the operative position, a lower end portion, to a stand. The first electrode is arranged near, in or on an upper end portion of the mast. The second electrode is arranged near, in or on the lower end portion of the mast. The mast and/or stand includes means which are arranged to keep the mast in a prescribed position. The mast and stand are formed substantially of non-magnetic materials.
