title: DETERMINATION OF TURBULENCE IN A FLUID AND CONTROL OF ARRAY OF ENERGY PRODUCING DEVICES
abstract: The invention relates to a method and device for approximating at least one quantity representative of turbulence in a marine flow by: • determining at least one profile of the marine flow; • selecting at least one eddy type representative of the turbulence, wherein each eddy type comprises at least one eddy size parameter and an eddy strength parameter; • determining a velocity signature and/or a turbulent intensity signature, for each selected eddy type; and • using at least one said determined signature to perform a deconvolution of the profile, in order to determine, for each selected eddy type, at least one probability density function as a function of the at least one size parameter and/or the strength parameter. Furthermore, the invention relates to different methods and devices for controlling the operation of devices adapted to convert kinetic energy of a fluid into electrical energy.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: MULTICHANNEL SONAR SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for systems and methods to provide accurate and compact multichannel sonar systems for mobile structures. A compact multichannel sonar system includes a multichannel transducer and associated processing and control electronics and optionally orientation and/or position sensors disposed substantially within the housing of a sonar transducer assembly. The multichannel transducer includes multiple transmission and/or receive channels/transducer elements. The transducer assembly is configured to support and protect the multichannel transducer and associated electronics and sensors, to physically and/or adjustably couple to a mobile structure, and/or to provide a simplified interface to other systems coupled to the mobile structure. The system may additionally include an actuator configured to adjust an orientation of the transducer assembly. Resulting sonar data and/or imagery may be displayed to a user and/or used to adjust a steering actuator, a propulsion system thrust, and/or other operational systems of the mobile structure.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Remote measurement of shallow depths in semi-transparent media
abstract: Through discrimination of the scattered signal polarization state, a lidar system measures a distance through semi-transparent media by the reception of single or multiple scattered signals from a scattering medium. Combined and overlapped single or multiple scattered light signals from the medium can be separated by exploiting varying polarization characteristics. This removes the traditional laser and detector pulse width limitations that determine the system's operational bandwidth, translating relative depth measurements into the conditions of two surface timing measurements and achieving sub-pulse width resolution.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Submerged buoy applied to marine observation
abstract: The invention discloses a submerged buoy applied to marine observation. The submerged buoy comprises a vertically-arranged mooring rope and also comprises a first temperature-salinity chain, a second temperature-salinity chain, a first microscale fixed-point turbulence meter, a second microscale fixed-point turbulence meter, a main floating body and a base body which are arranged on the upper part of the mooring rope; the base body is arranged at the top end of the mooring rope; a plurality of solar cell pieces used as power supplies are erected on the base body; each of the first temperature-salinity chain and the second temperature-salinity chain comprises a temperature instrument, a temperature-depth instrument and temperature-salinity-depth instrument; a doppler current profiler is mounted on the main floating body; a reciprocating type microscale turbulence profiler is arranged at the middle part of the mooring rope; a high-accuracy temperature-salinity-depth instrument and a single-point marine current meter are arranged at the lower part of the mooring rope; a plurality of satellite communication buoys used for unloading observation data are arranged on the main floating body; the satellite communication buoys are connected with the main floating body through a regular releasing device. The submerged buoy applied to marine observation is capable of regularly obtaining the observation data before withdrawing the submerged buoy and is high in practicability.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Systems and methods for robotic mapping
abstract: Systems and methods for robotic mapping are disclosed. In some exemplary implementations, a robot can travel in an environment. From travelling in the environment, the robot can create a graph comprising a plurality of nodes, wherein each node corresponds to a scan taken by a sensor of the robot at a location in the environment. In some exemplary implementations, the robot can generate a map of the environment from the graph. In some cases, to facilitate map generation, the robot can constrain the graph to start and end at a substantially similar location. The robot can also perform scan matching on extended scan groups, determined from identifying overlap between scans, to further determine the location of features in a map.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Geomorphological structure monitoring system
abstract: A geomorphological structure monitoring system is disclosed, which comprises a supporting base having an accommodating space and a plurality of through holes, and at least a portion of the supporting base is embedded under a ground; a plurality of sensing devices arranged in the accommodating space vertically and embedded under the ground, the sensing devices may generate a sensing signal when the sensing devices are exposed from the ground due to the structural change of the ground; a signal processing device receiving and processing the sensing signal; and a transmission device connecting the sensing devices in series and the signal processing device.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: System for measuring mechanical properties of sea floor sediments at full ocean depths
abstract: The present invention discloses a system for measuring the mechanical properties of sea floor sediments at full ocean depth. The system includes an overwater monitoring unit and an underwater measurement device, where the underwater measurement device includes an observation platform and a measuring mechanism; the observation platform includes a frame-type body and a floating body, a wing panel, a floating ball cabin, a leveling mechanism, a counterweight, and a release mechanism mounted on the frame-type body; the floating ball cabin seals a circuit system; the leveling mechanism adjusts the underwater measurement device horizontally on the sea floor when the frame-type body reaches the sea floor; the release mechanism discards the counterweight for recovery of the unit after the underwater measurement device completes the underwater operation; the measuring mechanism includes at least one of a cone penetration measuring mechanism, a spherical penetration measuring mechanism, and a vane shear measuring mechanism, or a sampling mechanism.
note: seabed lander, not a vehicle

title: WIND TURBINE WITH SEA LEVEL WAVE CHARACTERISTIC DETERMINATION
abstract: The present invention is directed to a wind turbine (1) configured to be disposed in or above a sea floor (S) and comprising a tower (2) configured to protrude from a sea level (S), a nacelle (3) and a hub (4). The wind turbine (1) further comprises a transmitter (10) configured to transmit a first electromagnetic wave (100) to be reflected on the sea level (S) and a receiver (20) configured to receive the reflected electromagnetic wave (200), wherein at least one of the transmitter (10) and the receiver (20) is arranged either at the nacelle (3), the hub (4) or the tower (2). The wind turbine further comprises a processing unit (30) being in communication with the receiver (20) and configured to analyse the reflected electromagnetic wave (200) such that a wave characteristic of the sea level (S) is determined.
note: wind turbine wave sensing

title: Compensating type transverse mooring very-low frequency vector acoustic horizontal submersible buoy
abstract: The invention provides a compensating type transverse mooring very-low frequency vector acoustic horizontal submersible buoy and relates to the field of marine environment detection equipment. The compensating type transverse mooring very-low frequency vector acoustic horizontal submersible buoy is to solve a problem that an existing marine environment can generate a larger effect on the integralattitude of a submersible buoy system so as to generate a larger effect on marine environment information obtaining of the submersible buoy system. A main buoy is connected with one end of an acousticreleaser through a rope; the other end of the acoustic releaser is connected with a sinking block; the main buoy is connected with a weak positive buoyancy horizontal submersible buoy through a slacking type combined vibration absorbing cable and a compensating type vibration absorber; the main buoy is used for providing an upward positive for the weak positive buoyancy horizontal submersible buoy to keep the depth stability of the submersible buoy; the compensating type vibration absorber is used for obstructing the transmission of vibration caused by the marine environment to the weak positive buoyancy horizontal submersible buoy; and the slacking type combined vibration absorbing cable possesses a certain slackness and is used for eliminating transmission of a vibration force, generated by using ocean current to push the main buoy, to the weak positive buoyancy horizontal submersible buoy; and therefore, the depth position of the weak positive buoyancy horizontal submersible buoy in seawater is stable. The compensating type transverse mooring very-low frequency vector acoustic horizontal submersible buoy is used for stabilizing the submersible buoy.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Supercavitating vehicle test model with elastic tail edge
abstract: The invention relates to a supercavitating vehicle test model with an elastic tail edge. According to the prior art, when an underwater vehicle is subjected to a pitching moment, the tail part of the underwater vehicle swings up and down so as to be subjected to a sliding force, as a result, the underwater vehicle tends to lose stability, and serious consequences can be brought about; cavities are closed at the tail part of the vehicle so as to form jet flow, and as a result, the jet flow will exert serious influence on the attitude of the vehicle. However, with the supercavitating vehicle test model with the elastic tail edge of the invention adopted, the problem in the prior art can be solved. The supercavitating vehicle test model with the elastic tail edge comprises a main body section, a connecting section, an air compressor, a first ventilation pipe and a second ventilation pipe. The supercavitating vehicle test model with the elastic tail edge further comprises a tail edge section, the elastic tail edge, a first sealing ring and a second sealing ring. The main body section comprises a cavitation device, a conical pipe section, a balance adapter and a cylindrical pipe section. The large opening end of the conical pipe section is fixedly connected with one end of the cylindrical pipe section through the balance adapter; and one end of the first ventilation pipe and one end of the second ventilation pipe are both connected with the output end of the air compressor through a three-way pipe. The supercavitating vehicle test model with the elastic tail edge of the invention is used for the underwater navigation field.
note: supercavitating underwater vehicle model

title: Observation device for hydrology and water resources engineering and use method of observation device
abstract: The invention discloses an observation device for hydrology and water resources engineering and a use method of the observation device. The observation device comprises a bottom fixed bracket, a detection supporting base, a warning light and a monitoring camera. Mounting top rods are arranged at four corners of the upper part of the bottom fixed bracket, the detection supporting base is arranged on the upper pars of the mounting top rods, and a hook is arranged on one side wall of the detection supporting base. The observation device has the beneficial effects that a liquid temperature sensorand a water quality monitor are arranged inside a water resource detection box body, the liquid temperature sensor and the water quality monitor can be prevented from being damaged by sundries in water, and the service life is prolonged; and the observation device can be fixed on the mounting top rods by fixing screws for use, can be fixed on a hull by the hook and can float on a lake surface or the sea surface through the floating force generated by a floating body for use, so that the use range is wider.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Dynamic draft correction device for GNSS tide level observation buoy
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic draft correction device for a GNSS tide level observation buoy. The device comprises an attitude stabilization part and an attitude compensation part, wherein the attitude compensation part comprises a data fusion module; calculation is performed to obtain a buoy dynamic draft correction value and a corrected real-time water surface geodetic height by adopting thefollowing formula; zeta = {(K + L telescopic)-[(P sensing-P atmosphere)/(rho * g)]/cos theta} * cos theta, h < water > = H-zeta, wherein in the formula, zeta is a buoy dynamic draft correction value;K is a modified normal number, L is the length of the telescopic marker post, P is a pressure value measured by the pressure sensor, P atmosphere is the pressure value measured by the barometer, theta is an included angle between the central line of the device measured by the inertial measurement unit and the vertical direction, H water is modified real-time water surface geodetic height, and H is geodetic height measured by the GNSS positioning module. The dynamic draft correction devicedisclosed in the invention can be used to reduce the influence of stormy waves and tides on the posture ofthe buoy, eliminate dynamic draft errors and improve the tide level observation precision of the GNSS tide level observation buoy.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Passive wireless piezoelectric sensor and passive monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a passive wireless piezoelectric sensor and a passive monitoring system. The passive wireless piezoelectric sensor comprises an energy absorption monitoring assembly, a piezoelectric transducer and a wireless communication assembly, wherein the energy absorption monitoring assembly is used for absorbing kinetic energy from a liquid in any direction and detecting the motionstate of the liquid; the piezoelectric transducer is connected with the energy absorption monitoring assembly and the wireless communication assembly, and is used for converting the kinetic energy into electric energy and outputting the electric energy; and the wireless communication assembly is used for receiving the electric energy and sending out liquid motion state information detected by theenergy absorption monitoring assembly as a wireless signal. By implementing the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the passive wireless piezoelectric sensor can realize long-term continuousself-power supply in a liquid environment, and is small in size, simple in structure and low in manufacturing cost.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Hydrographic surveying and mapping monitoring system for field river channel
abstract: The invention discloses a hydrographic surveying and mapping monitoring system for a field river channel, which relates to the technical field of hydrographic monitoring. The hydrographic surveying and mapping monitoring system comprises a first measuring frame, two groups of lifting mechanisms, four groups of turnover mechanisms, four groups of fixing mechanisms, an adjusting mechanism, a second measuring frame, a moving mechanism and a measuring mechanism, wherein the two groups of lifting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged below the first measuring frame; the four groups of turnover mechanisms are the same in structure, the four groups of turnover mechanisms are arranged below the lifting mechanism, the four groups of fixing mechanisms are respectively arranged on each group of turnover mechanisms, the adjusting mechanism is arranged on the first measuring frame, the second measuring frame is fixedly arranged on the adjusting mechanism, and the moving mechanism is arranged on the second frame. The measuring mechanism is fixedly arranged at the working end of the moving mechanism, through cooperative work of all the mechanisms, under the condition that the field environment is complex, monitoring equipment can be erected conveniently, adjustment can be conducted according to the water level change of a field river channel, and field construction is facilitated.

title: Submarine power generation and charging station for underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a submarine power generation and charging station for an underwater vehicle. The submarine power generation and charging station discloses a water power unit A structural body and a water power unit B structural body which are the same in structure and rotate reversely, and a low-speed alternating-current permanent magnet generator is arranged between the water power unit A structural body and the water power unit B structural body; the upper end of the water power unit A structural body is connected with a deep sea floating body through a Kevlar cable, the lower end of the water power unit B structural body is connected with the top of the large opening end of an underwater vehicle berthing device through a Kevlar composite transmission cable, a plurality of high-frequency sound source arrays are evenly distributed on the circumference of the outer side of the large opening end of the underwater vehicle berthing device, and the small opening end of the underwater vehicle berthing device is a power transmission coil; and mechanical arms are arranged at the two ends of the outer side of the power transmission coil, a storage battery bin set is arranged below the underwater vehicle berthing device, a central controller is arranged at the front end of the storage battery bin set, a low-frequency sound source transducer is arranged on the central controller, and the storage battery bin set is arranged on a gravity anchor. The submarine power generation and charging station is reasonable in structural design, good in charging effect, high in tidal current energy conversion efficiency and convenient and reliable to use.
note: seabed charging and docking station for underwater vehicles

title: BUOY FOR OFFSHORE SAFETY
abstract: A buoy for maritime management according to the present invention is a buoy composed of a floating part floating on the sea level, and a spindle part disposed under the floating part, and comprises: a light emitting part that is disposed on the floating part and emits light; an image recording part that is disposed on the floating part and acquires an image; a buoyancy sensing part disposed on the lower part of the floating part and the upper part of the spindle part to sense the state of the sea and the buoyancy state of the buoy; a wireless communication part for transmitting and receiving data acquired from the image recording part and the buoyancy sensing part to the outside; and a power part providing electric power to the light emitting part, the image recording part, the buoyancy sensing part, and the wireless communication part. The buoy for maritime management according to the present invention stably produces electric power by itself. By using the present invention, the marine environment can be more easily monitored.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Marine surveying and mapping equipment with positioning function
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine surveying and mapping, and particularly relates to marine surveying and mapping equipment with a positioning function, the marine surveying and mapping equipment comprises a base, a connecting pipe, a bracket and a buoyancy ball, the connecting pipe is vertically arranged on the base, through positioning, the bottom end of the connecting pipe is inserted into an inverted conical opening in the top of the base, and the buoyancy ball is arranged on the bracket under the cooperation of two magnets with different polarities. Accurate positioning of the bottom end of the connecting pipe is achieved, the bottom end of the base and the fixing nut are rotated in a matched mode through rotation matching, fixing of the connecting pipe is achieved, mounting and dismounting are easy and convenient, better maintenance is facilitated, a trigger ring makes contact with different extrusion shifting pieces, extrusion of the extrusion shifting pieces is achieved, and electrification of an indicator lamp can be recorded through a controller. The wind direction and time period of the ocean are recorded according to flashing and flashing time of the indicator lamps in different directions, the buoyancy ball floats up and down, the rising and falling state of the seawater can be recorded through the action track of the ink rod on the recording paper, better surveying and mapping data can be obtained in cooperation with wind direction detection, and the surveying and mapping accuracy is improved.

title: Ocean wind direction and ocean current direction monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean wind direction and ocean current direction monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of ocean monitoring, and the ocean wind direction monitoring method comprises the steps: collecting initial wind direction information in ocean wind; and when it is monitored that abnormal oscillation change exists in the initial wind direction information, carrying out at least one recording mode change on the initial wind direction information, eliminating the abnormal oscillation change existing in the initial wind direction information, and obtaining target wind direction information. The ocean current flow direction monitoring method comprises the following steps: collecting initial flow direction information in ocean current; and when it is monitored that abnormal oscillation change exists in the initial flow direction information, carrying out at least one recording mode change on the initial flow direction information, eliminating the abnormal oscillation change existing in the initial flow direction information, and obtaining target flow direction information. Through the method, the accuracy and the monitoring efficiency of ocean wind field or ocean current monitoring are improved.
note: ocean monitoring, buoy, sensor or other non-vehicle equipment

title: Underwater topographic measurement device and method
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater topography measuring device and method, the device comprises a measuring ship for measuring underwater topography and a transducer installed at the bottom of the measuring ship, the bottom of the measuring ship is provided with a containing cavity, and an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the angle of the measuring ship relative to the water surface is installed in the containing cavity; a supporting plate is arranged at the bottom of the surveying vessel, a linkage mechanism is arranged on the surveying vessel, the underwater topographic surveying device and method can prevent duckweed from being attached to the surface of the transducer, meanwhile, the situation that bubbles are generated in water to affect signal transmitting and receiving of the transducer is prevented, the underwater topographic surveying accuracy of the transducer is further improved, and meanwhile, the underwater topographic surveying device and method are convenient to operate. The removing mechanism can also play a role in assisting the measuring bed to move on the water surface, the energy consumption of the measuring ship is further reduced, meanwhile, through the linkage mechanism and the adjusting mechanism, the transducer and the supporting plate are always kept at an angle perpendicular to the water surface, and the measuring precision of the transducer is further improved.

title: Integrated floating and sinking disaster-avoiding power generation device based on photovoltaic power generation and wave power generation
abstract: The invention provides an integrated floating and sinking disaster-avoiding power generation device based on photovoltaic power generation and wave energy power generation. The integrated floating and sinking disaster-avoiding power generation device comprises a floating type photovoltaic power generation system, a pulse type wave energy power generation system, a floating and sinking monitoring system and an anchoring system. The floating type photovoltaic power generation system is composed of photovoltaic panels, the floating and sinking monitoring system is composed of a floating and sinking shell, an air bag, a monitoring sensor and an air suction pipe, and the pulse type wave energy power generation system is composed of a pulse pipe and a power generator. The anchoring system is composed of an anchor chain and a suction foundation, and the whole device is fixed through the anchoring system. The photovoltaic power generation system generates power through a photovoltaic panel. The pulse type wave energy power generation system generates power through the striking effect of seawater on the pulse pipe. The floating and sinking monitoring system controls floating and sinking of the whole device, and a sensor on the floating and sinking system is used for monitoring the surrounding hydrological environment, so that the power generation device can absorb waves and utilize the waves to generate power in normal weather; under the extreme weather condition, the device can sink to a deep water area with small wind wave influence, safe and stable operation of the device is ensured, and the dual power generation effect of solar energy and wave energy is achieved.

title: Complex marine environment deepwater pile group construction monitoring system constructed based on hydrological model
abstract: The invention provides a complex marine environment deepwater pile group construction monitoring system constructed based on a hydrological model. The complex marine environment deepwater pile group construction monitoring system comprises a hydrological model terminal, a marine environment monitoring terminal, a pile group construction monitoring terminal, a monitoring data analysis terminal and an alarm terminal. The marine environment monitoring terminal is used for monitoring a marine environment in a pile group construction area and generating marine environment monitoring information; the pile group construction monitoring terminal is used for monitoring a pile group construction site and generating pile group construction monitoring information; the hydrological model terminal is used for constructing a construction area hydrological model and updating the construction area hydrological model according to the marine environment monitoring information and the pile group construction monitoring information; the monitoring data analysis terminal is used for performing monitoring data analysis according to the marine environment monitoring information and the pile group construction monitoring information to generate data analysis information; the alarm terminal is used for generating alarm information according to the data analysis information. The method has the effect of improving the monitoring accuracy of deepwater pile group construction in the complex marine environment.

title: Hydrological comprehensive monitoring platform
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrological monitoring, and discloses a hydrological comprehensive monitoring platform which comprises a sliding rail base, mounting sliding rails are fixedly mounted on the left side and the right side of the sliding rail base, a mounting platform is arranged on the front face of the sliding rail base, and sliding strips are fixedly mounted on the left side and the right side of the mounting platform. And the mounting platform is movably clamped with the mounting sliding rails through the sliding strips. According to the invention, through utilization of buoyancy, input of external air and input of water flow, expansion of the rubber air bag is realized, and air density is smaller than that of water, and air is injected into the rubber air bag to realize floating of the device, so that the device floats on the water surface for measurement; water flow is injected into the rubber air bag so that the device can dive and go deep into water, the whole process only needs air of an air valve and opening of an air pump, remote operation can be achieved, manual folding and unfolding work is not needed, and the function of dynamically adjusting the monitoring height according to the actual detection requirement is achieved.

title: Apparatus and methods for subsea control system testing
abstract: Apparatus and method for subsea control system testing includes one or more of electrical, optical and fluidic conduit testing, wherein the testing is conducted subsea using a subsea testing skid; the skid comprises at least one testing module 70, 72, 74 for respective electrical, optical and fluidic conduit testing; at least one data logger to record measurements taken via said module; at least one hot stab 59 or flying lead (82, 86 fig.7) for connecting between the testing module and said subsea control system. The skid is preferably mounted to a remote operated vehicle ROV or AUV for maneuvering said skid in the water. The testing equipment mounted on the skid may further include a high pressure pump used to deliver from 3000 to 20000 p.s.i. of pressure for pressure testing the fluidic conduits, a fluid containment bladder, a test fluid filtration system and an optical time domain reflectometer for testing optical conduits.
note: testing skid mounted on an ROV/AUV

title: Remote automation system for CLPContainment Liner Plate thickness measurement using remote operated vehicle with link structure
abstract: The present invention relates to a remote automatic ultrasonic inspection system for inspecting thickness reduction and a void due to corrosion of a liner plate of a nuclear power plant containment building. The ultrasonic inspection system includes a remote control vehicle having a magnetic wheel and moving while being attached to a containment liner plate (CLP) by magnetic force, the remote control vehicle inspecting a thickness of the CLP by using a wheel-type ultrasonic probe; and a laser tracker that irradiates a laser to a reflector mounted on the remote control vehicle and obtains location information of the remote control vehicle by using reflected light, wherein the remote control vehicle includes: a first body having the magnetic wheel; a second body having a magnetic wheel; a first body connection part connected to the first body by a hinge to enable the first body to be rolled; and a second body connection part connected to the second body by a hinge to enable the second body to be rolled, and the first body connection part and the second body connection part are connected to each other. According to the above configuration, it is possible to provide a remote automatic ultrasonic inspection system rather than manual visual inspection of an operator in order to check thickness reduction and a void due to corrosion of the liner plate of a nuclear power plant containment building. Even when the remote control vehicle passes through a CLP welding part and an embedment plate attached to a CLP surface, the remote control vehicle can perform inspection while maintaining contact.
note: magnetic crawler in a nuclear containment building

title: Transition piece with conduit located around the pile of an offshore installation
abstract: Transition piece 10 to mount a conduit 18 to the pile 12 of an offshore installation at points above 32 and below 34 the mean sea level MSL without the need for divers or a remote operated vehicle. The transition piece 10 is located around the pile 12 of the offshore installation and comprises an extending portion 22 that extends downwardly below sea level MSL. Preferably the offshore installation is a wind turbine comprising a monopole 12, the conduit is one or more j-tubes 18 permanently mounted onshore to the transition piece 10, and the extending portion extends downwardly from an upper portion sleeve 20. The j-tubes may carry electric cables and may extend down to the sea bed 40 and upwardly through a passageway 46 in the pile 12 above the sea level MSL. The transition piece 12 may include an anode ring 50 and may allow adjustment of its vertical orientation relative to the pile 12 using jacks prior to grouting together.

title: Method of and apparatus for offshore mooring
abstract: In a method of and apparatus for offshore mooring, a clamping apparatus includes a clamping mechanism and a pulley. A mooring line connected to an anchor or a pendant line connected to a vessel to be moored extends through the clamping mechanism and around the pulley of the clamping apparatus. The distal end of the line extending through the clamping apparatus is connected to an anchor handling vessel. The anchor handling vessel is employed to apply a predetermined tension to the pendant line and the preset mooring line. A remote operated vehicle is then employed to actuate the clamping apparatus and to disengage the anchor handling vessel.
note: mooring clamp actuated by an ROV in the method

title: Improved device for quickly connecting joints underwater
abstract: The invention discloses an improved device for quickly connecting a plurality of joints underwater. The device comprises a fixed end and a mobile end, wherein the fixed end mainly comprises a male joint mounting plate, an elastic chuck mandrel, a center guide sleeve, a male joint, an external guide sleeve and a fixed mounting plate; the mobile end mainly comprises an ROV (remote operated vehicle) rotary interface, a transmission shaft, a limiting bearing, a transmission nut, a female joint mounting plate, a gasket, a protective sleeve, an elastic chuck, an external guide post, a female joint, a shear pin and a center guide post; the lateral wall of the protective sleeve of the mobile end is provided with an anti-sediment protective cover; an overload sleeve is arranged between the transmission nut and the elastic chuck of the mobile end. The improved device has the improvements that wing plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the lateral wall of the protective sleeve of the mobile end, the connection stiffness and convenience of the mobile end and a mounting base are effectively improved, and guide curved surfaces are processed on the inserting end part of the external guide post, so that the insertion process of the mobile end becomes relatively reliable and stable.

title: PROPULSOR WITH MOVABLE SPOKES
abstract: FIELD: engines.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to underwater transport propulsors, namely, to underwater robots propellers. Propulsor with movable spokes has cylindrical rim, rim drive shaft and radial spokes and equipped with cam and cam drive shaft. Rim rotational axis coincides with axis of shaft rotation. Cam has possibility to rotate around its drive shaft axis and be fixed at any angle. Radial spokes have flat part, which plane is parallel to axis of rotation, and cylindrical part, which protrudes beyond rim. Spoke flat part by one end passes through hole in rim cylindrical surface, and at opposite end has slot for hook-type sliding engagement with cam flat part. During cylindrical rim rotation radial spokes have possibility to perform reciprocal motions.EFFECT: enabling efficient underwater transport motion both in water and on underwater soil or ooze.1 cl, 5 dwg

title: Variable speed drive for subsea installations, vessels, and/or vehicles
abstract: A Variable Speed Drive (1) for subsea installations (20), subsea vessels or subsea vehicles, as well as to a corresponding subsea installation (20), subsea vessel or subsea vehicle, has an alternating current/alternating current converter (2) having a current-controlled capacitor-less direct current link (7).

abstract: The invention discloses a remote hydrological monitoring system which comprises a lifting mechanism, a telescopic mechanism, a water level sensor, a flow velocity sensor, an infrared camera and a control box. The telescopic mechanism is mounted at a top of the lifting mechanism. The control box is mounted on the telescopic mechanism. The water level sensor, the flow velocity sensor and the infrared camera are all mounted on a lower side surface of the control box in a suspended manner. A power supply module, a controller, a memory and a 4G communication module are arranged in the control box.According to the remote hydrological monitoring system, the 4G communication module can be used for sending water level data, flow velocity data and image information of a river channel to a remote control center, so that remote unmanned monitoring is realized. The position and height of the control box can be adjusted through the telescopic mechanism and the lifting mechanism, the installation ofriver channels of various sizes is satisfied, and the system has good universality.

title: Drone and rover preplacement for remote autonomous inspection of utility system components
abstract: Unmanned monitoring devices, such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), drones or rovers may survey an area of interest (AOI) such an electric power distribution system including generation, transmission, and distribution elements to automatically determine components in the AOI to be monitored. Types, placements locations, and pathways taken by other unmanned monitoring devices to facilitate the monitoring of the components of the AOI are also automatically determined.

title: Construction method for seabed bionic tree protection
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method for seabed bionic tree protection. The construction method comprises the steps that the number and positions of bionic trees are determined according to the size of an offshore wind power foundation and the area of a bionic tree protection area, and the determined bionic tree arrangement needs to fully cover the periphery of the foundation, and a certain margin is reserved; setting a construction route of the underwater robot in advance according to the position of the bionic tree; putting an underwater robot, dragging and carrying the bionic tree by the underwater robot, and sowing the bionic tree along a set route and a set sowing area. According to the method for sowing the bionic trees, the number and the positions of the bionic trees are determined according to the size of the offshore wind power foundation and the area of the protection area of the bionic trees, the bionic trees are put more accurately, and the reasonable positions enable the wind power foundation to achieve a more comprehensive anti-scouring effect; the bionic tree is a single body, the underwater robot drags and carries the bionic tree for operation, the requirement of a large workboat is omitted, and the installation cost is reduced; the underwater robot advances according to a set route, bionic trees are sown at set arrangement points, and errors are reduced.

title: Underwater detection system of river-sea direct ship
abstract: The invention provides an underwater detection system for a river-sea direct ship. The underwater detection system comprises a base, an adsorption device, a mechanical arm, a detection supporting platform and a detection device; the base is used for bearing and driving equipment on the underwater detection device; the adsorption device is used for adsorbing and fixing the base to a ship body, one end of the adsorption device is fixedly connected with the base, and the other end of the adsorption device is provided with an electromagnet used for being adsorbed to the ship body; the mechanical arm is used for adjusting the relative position between the detection supporting platform and the ship body, one end of the mechanical arm is in shaft connection with a first motor arranged on the base, and the other end of the mechanical arm is hinged to the detection supporting platform; and the detection supporting platform is used for supporting a detection device, and the detection device is arranged on the detection supporting platform. According to the invention, different areas and different angles of the underwater part of the ship body of the river-sea direct ship can be detected under the condition of not approaching the shore and not entering the dock, time and labor are saved, and the efficiency is high.

abstract: A method and system for mapping an object located on an ocean floor are presented. The method comprises acquiring sonar data of the object in order to form a first three-dimensional point cloud, acquiring photogrammetry data of the object in order to form a second three-dimensional point cloud, and acquiring positional data of the object in order to form a geographical reference grid related to the object. The method further comprise combining the first three-dimensional point cloud, the second three-dimensional point cloud and the geographical reference grid and generating a three-dimensional geographic representation of said object. Hereby, an accurate and versatile 3D mapping of underwater objects such as e.g. ship wrecks is achieved, whereby planning and execution of underwater missions related to these objects can be done with less uncertainties and at a lower cost. Also, a method for determining volume and content of a liquid contaminant contained within a tank of a sunken ship, based on the mapping method, is presented.

title: MARINE SUBSURFACE DATA CENTER VESSEL
abstract: The present invention provides a submersible data center vessel that is towed to its operating site, moored to anchors on the ocean floor and connected to an appropriate power generating system. The vessel is then submerged to its recommended operating depth while preferably still allowing air exchange and service crew access to the vessel interior. In the event of extreme weather/sea conditions, the vessel can be submerged deeper for the duration of the extreme conditions and out of range of harmful wind and wave forces. The subsurface vessel is preferably powered by a renewable energy source such as, but not limited to marine hydrokinetic energy provided by wave, tidal, or marine current electric generators and/or offshore wind turbines. Alternatively, an onshore electric power grid supplies a portion or all of the electric power by submarine cable to the vessel. The computer servers housed within the vessel are cooled by heat exchangers drawing from cool ocean water, and continue to operate irrespective of weather and sea conditions on the surface.

abstract: A Beidou-based hydrologic monitoring system comprises a data acquisition terminal, a server, a Beidou communication positioning unit and a client side; the data acquisition terminal is used for acquiring hydrometeorological data of channel waters and adjacent waters; the Beidou communication positioning unit is a data transmission channel between the data acquisition terminal and the server; the server is used for analyzing and processing data transmitted from the data collection terminal and pushing the processed data to the client side, and is also used for receiving configuration commands from the client side and pushing the commands to the data acquisition terminal. According to the Beidou-based hydrologic monitoring system provided by the invention, a Beidou communication satellite is used for transmission, so that functions of positioning, message data communication and time service are realized; through the message data communication function of a Beidou satellite navigation system, the characteristic that remote hydrological monitoring is free of geographical restrictions, and high in resistance to natural disasters is realized.

title: UNDERWATER FLOATING DEVICE AND DEPTH CONTROL METHOD
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable control for floatation/precipitation without increasing in size of a control mechanism to solve a conventional issue that an increase in weight of a device requiring floatation/precipitation may cause the mechanism for adjusting floatation of the device to also increase in size.SOLUTION: An underwater floating device 1 moored in water by a mooring rope comprises: a propeller 11 as thrust control means, which controls a thrust in a substantially horizontal direction and changes a depth where the own device is in; a rotary shaft 12; and a control part 14. Changing the thrust of the underwater floating device by this thrust control means can control the depth. Thereby, controlling floatation/precipitation of the underwater floating device is enabled without providing a large-sized mechanism and the like for the floatation adjustment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Underground unmanned vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an underground unmanned vehicle, which comprises a vehicle case, wherein four driving parts and a controller for controlling the driving parts are arranged on the machine case; each driving part comprises a motor and a propeller driven by the motor; the motor drives the propeller to positively rotate or reversely rotate so that the underground unmanned vehicle moves in the vertical direction; the power of the driving parts arranged at one side is different from the power of the driving parts arranged at the other side, so that the underground unmanned vehicle moves in the horizontal direction; the power of the driving parts in opposite corners is different from the power of the driving parts in opposite corners, so that the underground unmanned vehicle can steer. abstract: The invention discloses a remote sensing monitoring system for a water conservancy lake. The remote sensing monitoring system comprises a shell, a wind speed detector, a monitoring camera, a water quality detection head and a signal transmitter, wherein the top of the shell is fixedly connected with the bottom of a wind speed detector, and the inner side wall of the shell is fixedly connected with the end of a water quality detection head. title: PROCESS FOR HARVESTING, STORING, AND USING RENEWABLE ENERGY TO PROPEL AND POWER BOATS AND SHIPS, AND MAXIMIZE THEIR AVERAGE SPEED
abstract: A boat or ship (marine vessel) can be powered and propelled by using wind or solar energy. This propulsion results in the forward movement and six degrees of motion (roll, heave, pitch, yaw, surge, and sway) of the marine vessel. These motions have kinetic energy. This invention capitalizes on the fact that the solar wind and wave energy are cyclical by nature. The present invention enables the vessel to store energy harvested from these energy sources during periods when levels of energy is available from wind, solar, or the motion of the vessel in waves. This invention makes this stored energy available for use during periods when the external natural sources of energy (wind, wave, or solar) are not available in adequate quantities to maintain a reasonable speed of advance for the marine vessel. The harvesting of the energy during high energy cycles, storing it and using it when needed in this invention allows a marine vessel to get maximum speed of advance over a course. In this invention the marine vessel can maintain faster average speed without reliance on any fossil or chemical fuel and by only using renewable energy sources. In this invention the vessel is normally driven by wind channeling methods like canvas or foil sails or Flettner rotors. In addition to this, the vessel can be propelled by propulsion thrusters such as propellers, rim driven thrusters, azimuthing drives, water jets or other means of thrusting and propelling the vessel. These propulsion devices are driven by regenerative electric motors using stored electric energy in batteries on the vessel. The energy stored in the battery bank is used to provide supplemental or primary propulsion during cyclical periods when natural sources of wind, wave or solar energy are low. These same thrusters and their electric motors work in reverse to generate and harvest energy when wind levels are high and as the marine vessel is moving forward at higher speeds while being propelled by wind energy. In this invention the batteries, which are dense and heavy, to store this energy, are secured in the bottom of the marine vessel also serve as ballast to keep the vessel upright. This serves to lower the marine vessel's center of gravity to get the maximum hull stability for safety. This also helps the vessel channel maximum available wind energy to propel the vessel and harvest energy whenever stronger winds permit.
note: not an underwater vehicle or a component of one

abstract: The invention relates to an underwater vehicle docking control method based on reinforcement learning, belongs to the technical field of ocean control experiments, and introduces a reliable boundary updated by new and old strategies based on a PPO algorithm framework in deep reinforcement learning to improve the stability of agent learning. Meanwhile, a self-adaptive rollback cutting mechanism is adopted, the rollback strength is adjusted in a self-adaptive mode according to the situation that task successful completion experience is collected, and therefore the upper limit and the lower limit of new and old strategy updating are adjusted, and an intelligent agent is encouraged to explore in the initial training stage and converge stably in the later training stage. In the aspect of simulation training, a docking training environment considering ocean current and ocean wave interference is constructed, the training environment is used for intelligent body learning, and the anti-interference capability of the underwater vehicle is greatly improved.
note: underwater vehicle docking control

abstract: Method for monitoring a seabed (1) and/or a subsea structure (2), wherein measurement data concerning the seabed (1) and/or the subsea structure (2) is recorded using at least one sensor (4) attached to a ship (5), wherein a database (29) is provided comprising reference data concerning an expected state of the seabed (1) and/or subsea structure (2) or a state of the seabed (1) and/or subsea structure (2) during at least one previous measurement by the same sensor (4) and/or at least one further sensor, wherein part of the reference data is compared and/or merged and/or replaced with the measurement data concerning the same section of the seabed (1) or subsea structure (2) as that part of the reference data to generate output data (30).
